question:
Which tools are essential for diagnosing issues during implementation?
(Choose two)
answers: Adobe Cloud Manager
AEM Workflow Launcher
AEM Content Fragment Editor
Dispatcher Tools
correct: Adobe Cloud Manager
Dispatcher Tools
reason: Cloud Manager permite revisar resultados de los despliegues y controles de calidad que ayudan a localizar fallos de implementación. Dispatcher Tools permite validar y probar la configuración de Dispatcher. Los editores de contenido y los lanzadores de workflows cumplen otras funciones y no sustituyen estas herramientas de diagnóstico.

question:
An Architect is performing infrastructure and capacity planning for Author servers for a customer using AEM 6.5. Which two factors would lead the Architect to pick a multi-author instance architecture setup?
(Choose two.)
answers: Number of Parallel Authors
Website Traffic handled by servers
Cache Efficiency on the dispatcher
Fail safeness of the servers
Types of actions performed by Authors
correct: Number of Parallel Authors
Types of actions performed by Authors
reason: La cantidad de autores simultáneos y las operaciones que realizan determinan la presión real sobre Author: editar texto no consume lo mismo que importar miles de assets o ejecutar workflows. Estos datos permiten justificar y dimensionar una arquitectura con varios autores. El tráfico público y la eficiencia de Dispatcher afectan principalmente a Publish; la alta disponibilidad también debe evaluarse por separado.

question:
Which AEM features optimize multi-region content delivery?
(Choose three)
answers: Asynchronous replication
Geo-targeted content configurations
Integration with Adobe Analytics
Content delivery networks (CDN)
Multi-cloud deployments
correct: Geo-targeted content configurations
Content delivery networks (CDN)
Multi-cloud deployments
reason: Revisión de la clave: una CDN acerca las respuestas cacheadas al usuario y es la medida más directa para reducir latencia entre regiones. Las configuraciones geográficas seleccionan contenido adecuado, pero no aceleran por sí mismas su entrega. Una implantación multicloud puede distribuir infraestructura, aunque no es una capacidad automática de AEM ni una recomendación universal; la selección de tres respuestas resulta ambigua.

question:
Which methods should be employed to plan for AEM maintenance activities?
(Choose three)
answers: Regularly update JCR Data Store configurations
Ensure proper version control for updates
Schedule maintenance during off-peak hours
Automate dispatcher cache invalidation
correct: Ensure proper version control for updates
Schedule maintenance during off-peak hours
Automate dispatcher cache invalidation
reason: Versionar los cambios permite reproducirlos y revertirlos; programar tareas fuera de las horas de mayor actividad reduce su impacto. La invalidación de caché mantiene coherencia después de publicar cambios. Debe ser selectiva: vaciar toda la caché durante mantenimiento puede provocar una avalancha de solicitudes a Publish.

question:
A client recently purchased the Smart Content Service and is considering using the Enhanced Smart Tagging feature. As part of the process, the client recently created a new tagging taxonomy that has not been applied to any assets yet. An Architect needs to demonstrate the feature on a subset of the client's assets before using on all assets.
How should the Architect proceed?
answers: Enable Smart Tagging via the folder properties for a single folder of assets, then run the Smart Tags Training workflow
Enable Smart Tagging via the folder properties for a single folder of assets
Add sample assets to a new folder, tag assets in folder, then run the Smart Tags Training workflow
Add sample assets to a new folder, tag assets in folder, then enable Smart Tagging via the folder properties
correct: Add sample assets to a new folder, tag assets in folder, then enable Smart Tagging via the folder properties
reason: Revisión de la clave: las etiquetas inteligentes necesitan un modelo que reconozca la taxonomía deseada. Etiquetar manualmente ejemplos representativos proporciona material de entrenamiento, pero habilitar Smart Tagging no equivale necesariamente a entrenar el modelo. Si la taxonomía es nueva, hay que completar el entrenamiento, manual o automático según la configuración, y validar los resultados antes de aplicarlo masivamente.

question: A financial services client is planning to migrate their on-premise AEM solution to the cloud. What discovery task is most critical to this process?
answers: Reviewing existing content workflows
Identifying integration points with third-party systems
Analyzing user feedback on current website design
Setting up staging environments
correct: Identifying integration points with third-party systems
reason: Durante el descubrimiento hay que identificar los sistemas conectados, sus interfaces, responsables, datos y restricciones. Ese inventario permite detectar dependencias y diseñar la integración antes de elegir soluciones. Empezar por implementar conexiones sin conocer contratos, autenticación o volúmenes aumenta el riesgo de rehacer trabajo.

question:
A client is using fragmented systems to manage their digital assets with the following parameters:
- File servers, cloud hosting, etc. to store close to 30 TB worth of assets and a year-over-year increase of 3TB asset ingestion
- A tool developed in-house to create 50 resized versions of an asset while maintaining color accuracy for use in their various channels
- Amazon S3 for content delivery of the resized versions of the asset
Which solution should an Architect use to meet these requirements to migrate their existing platform to AEM 6.5?
answers: AEM Assets with Asset share commons implemented to handle assets delivery
AEM Assets connected to Dynamic media cloud services in Scene7 mode
AEM Assets with an offloading server configured for renditions
AEM Assets with the image server enabled using the dynamicmedia run-mode for renditions
correct: AEM Assets connected to Dynamic media cloud services in Scene7 mode
reason: Dynamic Media permite generar y entregar variantes de imágenes sin almacenar previamente todas las combinaciones en el repositorio de AEM. Para 30 TB de assets y decenas de renditions por original, reduce la proliferación de derivados y descarga trabajo de la plataforma editorial. Es necesario dimensionar la solución y configurar los perfiles de transformación y entrega.

question: Which approach is best for diagnosing and resolving issues encountered in the production environment?
answers: Immediately restart all AEM services
Isolate and replicate the issue in a staging environment
Disable all workflows temporarily
Delete the problematic content
correct: Isolate and replicate the issue in a staging environment
reason: Reproducir el problema en un entorno de staging comparable permite investigar sin introducir cambios experimentales en producción. Hay que conservar los datos relevantes del incidente, correlacionar logs y aislar la causa. Una vez corregida, se valida la solución con el mismo escenario que provocó el fallo.

question:
A client wants to change how they publish their content. Refer to the following client business requirements:
- The client has a seasonal business that has significant content changes across their site that need to be rolled out at once based on the season change over date.
- The content authors need to be able to work one season in advance of publish dates to ensure that all changes can be completed on time.
- The content authors need a way to indicate that all the seasonal changes are ready. If the content changes are not completed, then the pages should not get published.
- The content authors need the ability to modify the current live pages without rolling back changes for a future content rollout.
What approach should the Architect recommend?
answers: Use Launches inside of AEM for each new season and use the production ready flag to show changes are completed.
Use the Manage Publication with scheduling value set to the season change over date when changes are completed.
Create a Project inside of AEM for each new season and create a task for notifying that changes are completed.
Use the Versioning feature when editing a page to toggle and publish changes when ready.
correct: Use Launches inside of AEM for each new season and use the production ready flag to show changes are completed.
reason: Launches permite preparar una versión futura del contenido mientras el contenido actual sigue publicado. El equipo puede revisarla y dejarla preparada para su promoción en la fecha prevista. La marca de disponibilidad para producción forma parte de ese proceso; no sustituye las comprobaciones editoriales ni la configuración de promoción y publicación.

question: What is the primary advantage of using AEM as a Cloud Service for solution design?
answers: On-premise control
Manual scaling options
Auto-scaling for traffic fluctuations
Reduced flexibility for custom workflows
correct: Auto-scaling for traffic fluctuations
reason: AEM as a Cloud Service ajusta la capacidad para responder a variaciones de carga, reduciendo la necesidad de aprovisionar manualmente para cada pico. Esta elasticidad es una ventaja frente a una instalación de capacidad fija. Aun así, el código, las consultas y la estrategia de caché deben ser eficientes para aprovecharla.

question:
Which AEM features enhance reusability and efficiency in solution design?
(Choose two)
answers: Content fragments
Data obfuscation
Workflow launcher
Editable templates
correct: Content fragments
Editable templates
reason: Los Content Fragments separan el contenido estructurado de su presentación y permiten reutilizarlo en distintos canales. Las plantillas editables permiten reutilizar estructuras, componentes y políticas en las páginas. Son mecanismos complementarios: uno organiza contenido y el otro controla cómo los autores construyen las experiencias.

question: During discovery, you identify that the client's website has frequent downtime due to high traffic spikes. What would you recommend as a priority?
answers: Implement auto-scaling solutions
Optimize existing workflows
Redesign the user interface
Conduct end-user training
correct: Implement auto-scaling solutions
reason: El escalado automático permite absorber aumentos de demanda incorporando capacidad cuando hace falta. Para tráfico estacional debe combinarse con pruebas de carga, caché y límites de las integraciones externas. Escalar Publish no resuelve, por ejemplo, una base de datos externa saturada o una consulta ineficiente.

question:
An existing AEM 6.5 client has confidentiality agreements with business partners and uses AEM DAM to share documents with its partners. Through a Custom portal hosted in AEM, partners have access to a folder, named after the partners, where these files reside.
Some documents are shared with more than one partner, but the partners must not know with whom the documents are shared. The client struggles with maintainability because they copy files and keep track manually. Modifications and updates to documents should be done only once.
How should the Architect meet these requirements?
answers: Save the copy reference in the first file uploaded and run a workflow to propagate changes.
Use ALLOW, DENY rules at the user level to manage granular access control on files.
Utilize MSM for Assets and create asset live copies across the partner folders.
Create a generic name folder for files that are shared with more than one partner and apply ACL rules.
correct: Utilize MSM for Assets and create asset live copies across the partner folders.
reason: Las live copies de Assets permiten mantener variantes para distintos destinatarios y propagar cambios del origen mediante reglas de sincronización. Así se reduce el mantenimiento manual de copias independientes. La confidencialidad exige además permisos y canales de entrega adecuados: MSM organiza y sincroniza contenido, pero no reemplaza el control de acceso.

question: During implementation, the development team encounters integration issues with a third-party CRM. What should be the first step?
answers: Rewrite the integration logic from scratch
Validate API compatibility and authentication methods
Restart the AEM server to resolve potential conflicts
Use an AEM workflow to bypass the CRM integration temporarily
correct: Validate API compatibility and authentication methods
reason: Antes de integrar un CRM hay que comprobar qué API ofrece, cómo autentica las llamadas y qué operaciones y datos admite. Esto permite confirmar que el contrato técnico satisface los requisitos del proyecto. Después se concretan límites de uso, tiempos de espera, gestión de errores y protección de credenciales.

question: During implementation, you discover that a large number of workflows are causing system performance degradation. What action should you take?
answers: Disable all non-essential workflows temporarily
Upgrade the server hardware
Redesign workflows for better performance
Remove workflows with high resource usage
correct: Redesign workflows for better performance
reason: Un workflow lento debe analizarse por pasos para identificar consultas, llamadas externas o procesamiento que bloquea la ejecución. Rediseñarlo permite eliminar tareas redundantes y separar operaciones pesadas o asíncronas. Aumentar recursos sin revisar el flujo puede ocultar temporalmente el cuello de botella sin resolverlo.

question:
Which tools are commonly used to gather architecture-related requirements?
(Choose three)
answers: Network monitoring tools
Adobe Analytics
Stakeholder surveys
AEM Content Transfer Tool
correct: Network monitoring tools
Adobe Analytics
Stakeholder surveys
reason: Las entrevistas y encuestas identifican necesidades de los interesados; las analíticas muestran el uso real y la monitorización aporta datos sobre carga y comunicaciones. Juntas permiten formular requisitos apoyados en evidencia. Una herramienta de transferencia de contenido sirve para ejecutar una migración, no para descubrir por sí sola las necesidades del negocio.

question:
When documenting non-functional requirements, which factors should be prioritized?
(Choose two)
answers: Data security protocols
Project management methodology
System scalability
User interface design
correct: Data security protocols
System scalability
reason: La seguridad y la escalabilidad describen cualidades del sistema, por lo que son requisitos no funcionales. Deben expresarse de forma verificable, por ejemplo mediante controles de acceso exigidos o carga concurrente que se debe soportar. Una funcionalidad describe una acción concreta que el usuario o el sistema puede realizar.

question:
Which integration methods are recommended for third-party tools in AEM?
(Choose two)
answers: RESTful APIs
SOAP APIs
Sling models
Workflow processes
correct: RESTful APIs
Workflow processes
reason: Las API REST permiten intercambiar datos entre AEM y otros sistemas; los procesos de workflow pueden coordinar cuándo ejecutar esos intercambios dentro de un flujo de negocio. Un Sling Model organiza la lógica y los datos de un componente, pero no constituye por sí solo un protocolo de integración. SOAP también puede ser válido si lo exige el sistema externo.

question: A client needs a high-performance website to support global users with low latency. They also have strict compliance requirements for data localization. Which architecture design would best suit their needs?
answers: On-premise AEM deployment
AEM as a Cloud Service with multi-region deployment
Hybrid architecture with data stored on-premise and content delivered via CDN
Single-region deployment with manual backups
correct: AEM as a Cloud Service with multi-region deployment
reason: Revisión de la clave: una arquitectura regional puede ayudar a servir contenido cerca de los usuarios, pero no demuestra por sí sola el cumplimiento de residencia de datos. Hay que verificar dónde se almacenan y procesan contenido, copias de seguridad y datos personales, y qué despliegues admite el servicio contratado. CDN, distribución multirregional y cumplimiento normativo son aspectos distintos.

question:
Which strategies should be employed to ensure a successful feature upgrade process?
(Choose two)
answers: Notify end-users after deployment
Review system logs post-upgrade
Develop a rollback plan
Skip testing in staging environments
correct: Review system logs post-upgrade
Develop a rollback plan
reason: Un plan de actualización debe incluir una recuperación ensayada y criterios claros para decidir cuándo revertir. Tras desplegar, los logs y las comprobaciones funcionales permiten detectar incompatibilidades que no aparecieron antes. La recuperación debe considerar también el repositorio y los datos, no únicamente volver a desplegar el código anterior.

question:
What data is critical to assessing current architecture performance?
(Choose two)
answers: User session logs
API response times
Integration timelines
Data transfer protocols
correct: User session logs
API response times
reason: Las sesiones concurrentes ayudan a cuantificar la carga que soporta la aplicación, y la latencia de las API permite detectar integraciones que retrasan las respuestas. Conviene relacionar ambas métricas con errores y percentiles de tiempo de respuesta. Un promedio aislado puede ocultar problemas que afectan a una parte importante de los usuarios.

question: A global retailer is designing a new AEM website to support multi-language content. They also want to implement geo-targeting for promotions. What combination of features should be included in the solution design?
answers: AEM Live Copy and Content Fragments
Editable Templates and Dispatcher Configuration
Content Delivery Network (CDN) and Multi-Site Manager (MSM)
Geo-targeted Content Configurations and API-based integration
correct: Geo-targeted Content Configurations and API-based integration
reason: La integración de configuración geográfica permite seleccionar promociones o comportamiento según el mercado del visitante. No sustituye la gestión de idiomas: MSM y los procesos de traducción pueden mantener las variantes editoriales. La solución debe definir explícitamente cómo se determina la región y qué contenido se muestra cuando esa información no está disponible.

question: An Architect wants to use a web application firewall such as mod_security for Apache to provide cross-site scripting protection for their AEM Single Page application. Which technology should the Architect use to create XSS safe AEM components?
answers: Handlebar JS
NodeJS
ReactJS
HTL
correct: ReactJS
reason: React escapa los valores de texto insertados mediante JSX, lo que ayuda a impedir que una entrada se interprete como código ejecutable. Esa protección se pierde al insertar HTML sin sanear, por ejemplo mediante dangerouslySetInnerHTML. HTL ofrece protección contextual en el renderizado de AEM del lado servidor; una SPA necesita proteger también su propio renderizado en el navegador.

question: While implementing a solution, the team identifies recurring failures in the dispatcher cache invalidation process. What action should be taken first?
answers: Reconfigure the dispatcher flush agent
Migrate cache rules to a new instance
Conduct a full cache purge
Update dispatcher logs for better visibility
correct: Reconfigure the dispatcher flush agent
reason: Si la invalidación no llega a Dispatcher, hay que comprobar el agente de flush, su destino, credenciales, cola y respuesta HTTP. Corregir esa configuración restablece la actualización de la caché tras publicar. La investigación debe confirmar primero dónde se interrumpe el flujo, en lugar de cambiar parámetros o vaciar cachés sin evidencia.

question:
What are the benefits of conducting regression testing during implementation?
(Choose two)
answers: Improving website performance
Ensuring legacy functionality remains intact
Validating compliance with design standards
Identifying integration issues
correct: Ensuring legacy functionality remains intact
Validating compliance with design standards
reason: Revisión de la clave: las pruebas de regresión comprueban que los cambios no rompan comportamientos que antes funcionaban, incluidas integraciones existentes. También pueden cubrir aspectos visuales si se han definido pruebas para ellos. El cumplimiento del diseño no queda garantizado por ejecutar regresión genérica; depende de las aserciones y de la cobertura de la suite.

question:
A customer has an international presence and a strong brand image. The customer considers the exceptional quality images used for both print and on the website to be essential for its business. The customer uses AEM 6.5 managed services with a configuration of 2 dispatchers, 2 publishers, and 1 author. The original images can weigh up to 500Mb with videos weighing even more.
Renditions are generated after files are uploaded to AEM DAM by the Design team so the Authoring team can use them on the website. The teams report issues with platform stability and slowness. Visitors report that images look pixelated on some screens and pages are very slow to load.
Which two actions should the Architect take to resolve these issues?
(Choose two.)
answers: Train the design team to upload smaller assets and save the originals elsewhere
Optimize renditions for the different viewports used by the visitors
Add more dispatchers and publishers to the AEM configuration
Allocate more memory to ImageMagick and FFmpeg
Split AEM Assets and Sites in two different stacks and use Connected Assets
correct: Optimize renditions for the different viewports used by the visitors
Split AEM Assets and Sites in two different stacks and use Connected Assets
reason: Separar las cargas de Sites y Assets evita que el procesamiento intensivo del DAM compita con la edición y publicación de páginas. Connected Assets permite reutilizar los assets del repositorio remoto. Para evitar pixelación hay que entregar renditions con resolución suficiente para cada uso; separar servidores no corrige por sí solo una variante de imagen demasiado pequeña.

question:
A client is preparing to launch its new website on AEM. The Architect must check the platform prior to launch to identify system weaknesses and ways to exploit the applications.
Which two types of testing should the Architect perform on the system?
(Choose two.)
answers: Penetration Testing
Regression Testing
Load Testing
Unit Testing
Functional Testing
correct: Penetration Testing
Load Testing
reason: Revisión de la clave: una prueba de penetración busca vulnerabilidades explotables y es la elección directa para evaluar ataques. Las pruebas de carga miden capacidad y degradación; pueden aportar evidencia frente a agotamiento de recursos, pero no sustituyen una evaluación de seguridad. Presentarlas como una segunda prueba general de explotación hace que la pregunta sea imprecisa.

question:
Which testing requirements should be included in a solution design for a global website?
(Choose two)
answers: Usability testing
Regression testing
Load testing
Localization testing
correct: Load testing
Localization testing
reason: Las pruebas de carga validan el comportamiento bajo demanda concurrente, y las de localización comprueban idiomas, formatos y adaptación a los mercados. Para una implantación global también interesa ejecutar mediciones desde distintas regiones. Traducir correctamente una interfaz no garantiza que responda con la latencia requerida en todos los países.

question: Which component of AEM architecture ensures efficient delivery of static assets to end-users?
answers: AEM Dispatcher
JCR Repository
Sling Framework
CRXDE Lite
correct: AEM Dispatcher
reason: Dispatcher entrega contenido cacheado desde el servidor web y evita que cada solicitud llegue a Publish. Es especialmente útil para páginas y recursos que pueden compartirse entre visitantes. Las reglas de caché e invalidación deben distinguir ese contenido de las respuestas privadas o dependientes del usuario.

question:
A fashion retailer uses AEM with four publish servers to serve customers across the globe. The external users are kept in sync across the publish servers using Sling Content Distribution.
During a new product launch, the authoring team publishes hundreds of product pages. Numerous users who registered during that day notice that their profile information (preferences, photo) is not available when they log in.
After debugging, the Architect notices the following variables:
- Certain profiles are not synced with all publishers
- The heap dump shows no memory leaks
- The thread dumps and top command outputs show long-running replication threads and normal CPU utilization
- The Sling Content Distribution logs show no errors
What is preventing users from accessing their profile information?
answers: The truststore certificate has expired.
The default thread pool is full.
Sling Content Distribution is not configured properly.
The publishers do not have unique Sling IDs.
correct: The default thread pool is full.
reason: Solicitudes que esperan durante mucho tiempo con CPU normal pueden indicar agotamiento del pool de threads, por ejemplo por operaciones de red bloqueantes. Un thread dump permite comprobar cuántos hilos están ocupados y en qué esperan. Cambiar identificadores de usuario no resuelve un límite de concurrencia; aumentar el pool sin investigar la espera tampoco elimina la causa.

question:
A multinational beauty company uses AEM to host websites for all of its brands. Each brand runs new campaigns on a regular basis and often in parallel.
The campaigns begin with targeted advertisements on online channels to bring the users back to the website. The success of each campaign is measured through conversion ratings in Adobe Analytics. Recently users report that the website performance is degrading.
While investigating the issue, an Architect determines the following:
- Campaign tracking is done through a different URL query parameter
- Another URL query parameter is used for critical dynamic application functionality like searches
- Log analysis shows that the performance starts to degrade when many requests from the campaigns land on AEM
What should the Architect do to resolve this issue?
answers: Allow a wildcard but deny the dynamic query parameters in the /ignoreUrlParams section on the Dispatcher
Rewrite the query parameters to selectors to leverage Dispatcher caching
Deny a wildcard but allow the dynamic query parameters in the /filter section on the Dispatcher
Deny a wildcard but allow the campaign query parameters in the /filter section on the Dispatcher
correct: Allow a wildcard but deny the dynamic query parameters in the /ignoreUrlParams section on the Dispatcher
reason: Los parámetros de seguimiento pueden hacer que Dispatcher omita la caché aunque no cambien el contenido de la página. ignoreUrlParams permite ignorarlos a efectos de caché y conservar las excepciones para parámetros funcionales. Las reglas de /filter controlan el acceso, no este comportamiento; ignorar parámetros que sí cambian la respuesta podría servir contenido incorrecto.

question: During maintenance, you identify that outdated content is being served due to caching issues. What is the best course of action?
answers: Rebuild the entire dispatcher cache
Adjust cache invalidation rules
Clear all browser caches for end-users
Increase dispatcher flush agent intervals
correct: Adjust cache invalidation rules
reason: Si se entrega contenido antiguo después de una publicación, hay que revisar qué rutas se invalidan y cuándo llegan los eventos de flush. Una invalidación coherente permite reutilizar la caché sin mantener versiones obsoletas. Reducir indiscriminadamente todos los tiempos de vida puede aumentar la carga y no corregir una ruta o un agente mal configurados.

question:
A client enables SSO in the AEM Authoring instance using SAML for the content authors. The client plans to cross skill their marketing team to use AEM.
However, the marketing team uses their personal Adobe ID to login to the Marketing cloud products such as Analytics and Target on Admin Console. The client wants to enable the usage of company credentials for all their solutions to enforce standardized security policies.
What should the Architect propose to meet these requirements?
answers: Create a new SAML profile in the client IDP to integrate to the Marketing Suite products
Configure Adobe IMS to forward sign in for Adobe ID to the client IDP
Onboard all users to Adobe IMS using Enterprise ID
Onboard all users to Adobe IMS using Federated ID
correct: Onboard all users to Adobe IMS using Federated ID
reason: Federated ID permite que la organización autentique a sus usuarios con su propio proveedor de identidad y sus políticas corporativas. Es apropiado cuando los empleados deben acceder con las cuentas de empresa. La federación establece la identidad; los permisos y la asignación de productos siguen necesitando configuración independiente.

question: Which AEM feature is most useful for optimizing non-functional requirements in a live environment?
answers: AEM Content Fragments
Dispatcher caching
Editable templates
JCR Data Store
correct: Dispatcher caching
reason: La caché de Dispatcher reduce el número de peticiones que requieren renderizado y acceso al repositorio en Publish. Por eso contribuye directamente a objetivos no funcionales de latencia y capacidad. Su eficacia debe medirse con la tasa de aciertos y los tiempos de respuesta, manteniendo reglas correctas para invalidación y contenido autenticado.

question:
What actions should be taken to prototype new components during implementation?
(Choose three)
answers: Develop in staging environments
Conduct usability tests
Use reusable editable templates
Skip performance testing for prototypes
Test directly in production
correct: Develop in staging environments
Conduct usability tests
Use reusable editable templates
reason: Un prototipo en staging permite validar la propuesta con usuarios antes de extenderla al sitio completo. Las pruebas de usabilidad comprueban si los flujos y la edición resultan comprensibles, mientras las plantillas editables favorecen estructuras reutilizables. Un prototipo sirve para contrastar hipótesis y requisitos; no sustituye las pruebas de rendimiento y seguridad de la solución final.

question: What is the most important consideration when defining non-functional requirements for a global website?
answers: User interface design
Geographical performance optimization
Marketing automation tools
Personalization strategies
correct: Geographical performance optimization
reason: En un sitio global, el rendimiento debe medirse desde las regiones donde se encuentran los usuarios. La distancia a los servidores y a las cachés introduce latencia aunque el entorno funcione bien en una prueba local. El requisito debe fijar tiempos y condiciones de medición por región para que sea comprobable.

question: Which non-functional requirement is most relevant when designing a globally distributed website?
answers: Accessibility compliance
Multi-region content delivery
Search engine optimization (SEO)
Marketing campaign automation
correct: Multi-region content delivery
reason: Una estrategia de entrega distribuida reduce la distancia entre el usuario y el contenido y puede mejorar la continuidad del servicio. Debe definir qué se cachea, dónde se sirve y cómo se actualizan las copias. La distribución geográfica debe respetar también las restricciones de residencia y no confundirse con replicar todos los datos a todos los países.

question:
Which key performance metrics should be included in a solution design?
(Choose two)
answers: Content activation latency
Server uptime percentage
User interface color contrast
Database replication time
correct: Content activation latency
Server uptime percentage
reason: La latencia de activación mide cuánto tarda un cambio editorial en estar disponible para los visitantes. El uptime mide disponibilidad, otra dimensión de la calidad operativa. Usar ambas métricas ayuda a detectar retrasos de publicación y periodos de indisponibilidad, aunque técnicamente no son la misma clase de indicador de rendimiento.

question:
A news portal AEM client is complaining of performance issues on their site. The site has a particular traffic access pattern where about 90% of the traffic is concentrated on a small fraction of the following content pages.
- The Home Page
- Campaign Landing Pages
- Featured News Pages
Which approach should the Architect take to avoid any future performance issues?
answers: Implement cache flushing from Publish
Implement cache flushing from Author
Add ".jpg" and ".png" to the auto-invalidation configuration in the Dispatcher
Implement a Re-fetching Flush Agent
correct: Implement a Re-fetching Flush Agent
reason: El refetch vuelve a solicitar contenido después de invalidarlo para precalentar la caché. Esto reduce el coste que sufrirían los primeros visitantes de páginas muy consultadas tras un flush. Debe limitarse y dimensionarse para no generar más solicitudes simultáneas de las que Publish puede procesar.

question:
What are the benefits of defining content workflows during the discovery phase?
(Choose two)
answers: Enhanced personalization
Streamlined publishing processes
Improved content governance
Faster page load times
correct: Streamlined publishing processes
Improved content governance
reason: Para diseñar workflows hay que conocer quién crea, revisa, aprueba y publica el contenido, además de sus reglas de gobierno. Estas decisiones determinan participantes, permisos, condiciones y trazabilidad. Automatizar primero y descubrir después las responsabilidades suele producir flujos que no reflejan el proceso real del negocio.

question: Which business requirement is best supported by AEM's content fragment feature?
answers: Automating marketing campaigns
Delivering structured content across multiple channels
Optimizing website performance
Personalizing user experiences
correct: Delivering structured content across multiple channels
reason: Los Content Fragments almacenan contenido estructurado sin imponer un diseño de página. El mismo contenido puede consumirse desde la web, aplicaciones y otros canales mediante interfaces de entrega. Los Experience Fragments son más adecuados cuando interesa reutilizar una experiencia compuesta que también incluye presentación.

question: What should be prioritized during the implementation of a scalable architecture?
answers: Minimizing the use of content fragments
Optimizing resource-intensive workflows
Reducing the number of publish instances
Avoiding dispatcher rules for caching
correct: Optimizing resource-intensive workflows
reason: Los workflows intensivos pueden competir por CPU, memoria y acceso al repositorio con la actividad editorial. Optimizar pasos, consultas y concurrencia mejora la capacidad sin multiplicar innecesariamente servidores. Las tareas costosas pueden requerir ejecución asíncrona u offloading, manteniendo las dependencias necesarias para que el contenido quede listo para su uso.

question:
A customer cyber security officer reports that the company's website was used in a phishing campaign. Website visitors were tricked into clicking malicious advertisements that suddenly appeared on their website. An Architect's preliminary investigation showed that no code injection happened in AEM backend or in the browser.
What should the Architect do to protect the website?
answers: Make sure the frame-src directive of the Content-Security-Policy header is configured
Make sure the Strict-Transport-Security header is configured
Make sure the X-Frame-Options header is configured
Look for and remove any context='unsafe' statement in Sightly code
correct: Make sure the X-Frame-Options header is configured
reason: Una superposición engañosa sobre una página legítima corresponde a un ataque de clickjacking. X-Frame-Options restringe si la página puede mostrarse dentro de un frame; una política CSP frame-ancestors puede expresar controles más detallados. Estos mecanismos protegen contra el enmarcado no autorizado, pero no resuelven todas las formas de phishing.

question: What is the primary objective of planning for feature upgrades in AEM?
answers: To minimize downtime during implementation
To reduce the number of AEM instances
To ensure compatibility with existing integrations
To streamline deployment processes
correct: To ensure compatibility with existing integrations
reason: Una actualización puede cambiar API, bundles, configuración y dependencias utilizadas por las integraciones. Comprobar su compatibilidad antes del despliegue permite planificar adaptaciones y pruebas. Que el núcleo de AEM arranque correctamente no demuestra que los sistemas conectados sigan intercambiando datos como se espera.

question:
What steps should be taken to resolve design issues during implementation?
(Choose two)
answers: Optimize dispatcher caching rules
Update business requirements
Add user training modules
Expand content taxonomy
Conduct performance profiling
correct: Optimize dispatcher caching rules
Conduct performance profiling
reason: Revisar las reglas de caché permite localizar solicitudes evitables a Publish; el profiling permite identificar el código o las operaciones que consumen tiempo y recursos. Son técnicas complementarias para investigar problemas de rendimiento. La selección se refiere a ese tipo de problema: un defecto visual o de permisos requeriría otras comprobaciones específicas.

question:
A client wants to incorporate AEM into their technology stack. The client runs a third-party platform that owns the pages and their layouts. The client's marketing team needs to be able to use AEM to create content that can be consumed into that platform and displayed directly on pages as HTML.
Which AEM feature should an Architect use to support the client's request?
answers: Content Fragments
Experience Fragments
Assets API
Sling Models
correct: Experience Fragments
reason: Si el sistema externo necesita HTML listo para utilizar, un Experience Fragment conserva la composición de componentes y presentación que se quiere reutilizar. Un Content Fragment entrega principalmente contenido estructurado para que el consumidor lo presente. Hay que asegurar que estilos, scripts y referencias a assets sean accesibles desde el canal receptor.

question: Which artifact provides essential insights for documenting functional requirements during the discovery phase?
answers: Architecture diagram
Requirements traceability matrix
Project budget plan
Content inventory
correct: Content inventory
reason: Un inventario de contenido identifica tipos, cantidades, relaciones y variantes que la solución deberá soportar. Sirve de base para concretar modelos, plantillas y procesos editoriales. Debe complementarse con los requisitos de los interesados: conocer las páginas existentes no revela por sí solo todas las funciones nuevas que necesita el negocio.

question: Which tool is most effective for monitoring system health in an AEM production environment?
answers: AEM Workflow Launcher
Adobe Cloud Manager
CRXDE Lite
Dispatcher Configuration Tool
correct: Adobe Cloud Manager
reason: Cloud Manager proporciona información del ciclo de despliegue y comprobaciones del entorno en los servicios compatibles. Puede ayudar a detectar problemas de calidad y operación vinculados a una entrega. El diagnóstico de una incidencia concreta también requiere logs, métricas y, cuando corresponda, herramientas de monitorización de la aplicación.

question:
What are the key benefits of using Adobe Cloud Manager for maintenance?
(Choose two)
answers: Proactive alerts for system anomalies
Automated rollout of custom workflows
Real-time performance monitoring
Direct content repository management
correct: Proactive alerts for system anomalies
Real-time performance monitoring
reason: La visibilidad operativa y las alertas permiten detectar degradaciones y actuar antes de que afecten a más usuarios. Cloud Manager aporta controles y datos ligados a los entornos y pipelines que gestiona. El alcance de sus métricas y notificaciones depende del servicio; no debe confundirse automáticamente con una herramienta APM que trace todas las llamadas en tiempo real.

question: A client builds out a large set of Experience Fragments and wants to consume these fragments into another system. However, there are problems due to relative paths for the images in the HTML. How should an Architect resolve this issue?
answers: Use the plain selector when requesting the experience fragment
Modify the Experience Fragment component Sling Model
Add a Context Aware configuration for the external domain
Create a Sling Transformer that externalizes all image references
correct: Use the plain selector when requesting the experience fragment
reason: El selector .plain permite obtener una representación HTML de un Experience Fragment orientada a su reutilización externa, con reescritura de referencias. La configuración de Externalizer debe proporcionar los dominios correctos para generar enlaces utilizables fuera de AEM. Cambiar únicamente la extensión no garantiza que los assets y estilos del fragmento sean accesibles al consumidor.

question:
Which features should be considered to ensure a scalable AEM solution?
(Choose three)
answers: Auto-scaling of author instances
Use of content fragments
Horizontal scaling of publish instances
Dispatcher caching configuration
Synchronous data replication
correct: Use of content fragments
Horizontal scaling of publish instances
Dispatcher caching configuration
reason: Añadir instancias Publish distribuye la carga, mientras Dispatcher evita renderizados repetidos mediante caché. Los Content Fragments facilitan reutilizar contenido entre canales y desacoplar su presentación. Esta última ventaja es de arquitectura y mantenimiento: usar fragments no incrementa por sí mismo la capacidad de procesamiento.

question:
Which elements should be included when assessing a client's current architecture?
(Choose two)
answers: End-user training processes
Current content taxonomy
Network latency metrics
Data flow between systems
correct: Network latency metrics
Data flow between systems
reason: Los diagramas de flujo de datos permiten identificar qué sistemas participan en cada operación y cuántas llamadas requiere una respuesta. Relacionarlos con la latencia revela dependencias lentas y puntos donde introducir caché, procesamiento asíncrono o límites de tiempo. La arquitectura debe presupuestar el tiempo del recorrido completo, no solo el de AEM.

question: During the implementation of a public-facing website based on AEM as a Cloud Service, the customer raises an additional requirement to have a commenting functionality for end users implemented on the pages. What should the Architect do to make the design a future proof solution?
answers: Save comments in JCR and leverage reverse replication to synchronize comments via author
Use MongoDB as provided with AEM as a Cloud Service to store the comments
Save comments in JCR and leverage Sling Distribution to synchronize comments between publishers
Integrate a third-party solution to store comments externally
correct: Integrate a third-party solution to store comments externally
reason: En AEM as a Cloud Service, los comentarios de visitantes deben persistirse en un servicio externo diseñado para ese dato. Las instancias Publish pueden reemplazarse o escalarse, por lo que no deben utilizarse como almacenes locales de información generada por usuarios. El servicio externo debe gestionar consistencia, permisos y disponibilidad entre todas las instancias.

question: A production environment faces periodic downtime due to high traffic spikes. What immediate steps should you take to resolve this?
answers: Scale publish instances horizontally
Redesign content workflows
Increase dispatcher cache invalidation frequency
Optimize API integrations
correct: Scale publish instances horizontally
reason: El escalado horizontal de Publish añade capacidad para atender solicitudes concurrentes y puede aportar redundancia. Requiere balanceo de carga, comprobaciones de salud y contenido consistente entre instancias. Antes de dimensionarlo conviene comprobar la caché y los cuellos de botella, porque una dependencia compartida saturada puede limitar todo el conjunto.

question: A retailer wants to introduce personalization on their website using AEM. During discovery, what is the first step you should take?
answers: Define user personas
Create a content taxonomy
Set up analytics tracking
Conduct a security audit
correct: Define user personas
reason: La personalización comienza definiendo objetivos, audiencias y criterios de éxito. Las personas y segmentos ayudan a decidir qué experiencia resulta relevante para cada grupo y qué datos hacen falta. Implementar reglas sin esa definición dificulta medir si el cambio mejora el resultado y puede introducir complejidad sin valor.

question:
Which considerations are critical when recommending migration strategies?
(Choose three)
answers: Amount of content to be migrated
Time required for migration
Content taxonomy structure
Analytics tracking setup
Existing network latency issues
correct: Amount of content to be migrated
Time required for migration
Content taxonomy structure
reason: El volumen de contenido determina el esfuerzo y la duración potencial de la transferencia; la ventana disponible limita la estrategia de corte. La taxonomía y la estructura de destino determinan las transformaciones y validaciones necesarias. Estos factores permiten elegir entre cargas completas, incrementales y etapas de migración verificables.

question: A customer's AEM Sites platform has recently gone live. The customer uses Cloud Manager to run the standard tests, and the test results do not show any issues. After going live, the website visitors report very slow response times. The Architect needs to confirm performance is sufficient when going live with a new platform. Which additional test should the Architect perform to meet this requirement?
answers: Execute an accessibility test to show if the platform has a high enough level capacity to perform correctly.
Run a scalability test to determine if the performance is adequate.
Run an additional stress test to highlight where the systems boundaries are to re-evaluate sizing of the instances.
Run a performance and availability test through the standard cloud manager testing suite to identify performance gaps.
correct: Run an additional stress test to highlight where the systems boundaries are to re-evaluate sizing of the instances.
reason: Superar las pruebas funcionales no demuestra que la aplicación soporte sus condiciones reales de carga. Una prueba de estrés ayuda a localizar el punto de saturación y a observar cómo falla y se recupera el sistema. Debe complementarse con pruebas de carga representativas y objetivos de latencia, en vez de limitarse a comprobar que la aplicación no se cae.

question: A site hosted on AEM needs to integrate a new third-party recommendation REST service that provides the user with additional guidance for a central use case based on the user's browsing behavior. The site currently complies with an SLA of 99.5% uptime. The recommendation service also offers the same 99.5% uptime according to its SLAs. Which integration approach should an Architect take to meet these requirements and maintain the existing uptime?
answers: Implement a fallback in case the recommendation service is unavailable
Add retries with exponential backoff and fail after 1 minute
Retrieve and store potential recommendations in JCR nightly and use this data
Improve the AEM production setup to comply with 99.9% uptime
correct: Implement a fallback in case the recommendation service is unavailable
reason: Si una función depende de dos servicios, la indisponibilidad de cualquiera puede afectar al usuario. Un fallback y el aislamiento de fallos permiten ofrecer una respuesta degradada cuando una dependencia no está disponible. Los reintentos deben tener límites: por sí solos no garantizan disponibilidad y pueden agravar una saturación.

question:
Which factors are critical for resolving integration issues during implementation?
(Choose two)
answers: Verify API documentation
Optimize server configurations
Conduct end-user testing
Check authentication methods
correct: Verify API documentation
Check authentication methods
reason: La documentación de la API define operaciones, formatos, límites y errores; el mecanismo de autenticación establece cómo acceder de forma autorizada. Ambos son requisitos previos para diseñar una integración fiable. También deben acordarse la renovación de credenciales, los tiempos de espera y el tratamiento de fallos.

question: What is the first step in diagnosing a performance issue in a production AEM environment?
answers: Analyze server logs for errors
Restart the AEM instance
Reconfigure the dispatcher
Roll back recent updates
correct: Analyze server logs for errors
reason: Los logs permiten reconstruir qué ocurrió, en qué momento y para qué solicitudes o componentes. Correlacionarlos con cambios recientes y métricas ayuda a distinguir causas de síntomas. Reiniciar sin recoger evidencia puede recuperar temporalmente el servicio, pero también eliminar información necesaria para corregir el problema.

question: What is a primary consideration when designing an AEM solution for an e-commerce client?
answers: Content caching and invalidation
UI responsiveness
Multilingual SEO optimization
Dispatcher configuration
correct: Content caching and invalidation
reason: La integración comercial debe diferenciar información pública cacheable de datos variables o privados, como carritos y precios personalizados. Las reglas de invalidación y caducidad deben mantener la frescura necesaria sin consultar innecesariamente al sistema de comercio. Compartir en caché una respuesta dependiente del usuario puede producir errores funcionales y exponer información.

question: A client approaches an Architect with multiple design layouts for a new page. The client wants to run A/B testing on the layouts before making a final choice. What should the Architect do to meet this requirement?
answers: Create a new template and generate a test page for each layout
Create a new page with a version for each layout
Create a new experience fragment with a variation for each layout
Create a content fragment model and generate a new content fragment for each layout
correct: Create a new experience fragment with a variation for each layout
reason: Las variaciones de Experience Fragments permiten preparar alternativas de una misma experiencia y exportarlas a Target. Una actividad de prueba A/B distribuye esas alternativas y mide el resultado con un objetivo definido. Crear variaciones por sí solo no ejecuta un experimento: faltan la asignación de tráfico, las métricas y el análisis.

question: What is the key benefit of including content fragments in a solution design?
answers: Enhances UI performance
Enables reuse of structured content
Optimizes personalization algorithms
Improves search indexing
correct: Enables reuse of structured content
reason: Los Content Fragments utilizan modelos que definen campos y relaciones, lo que facilita contenido consistente y reutilizable. Cada canal puede presentar esos datos de acuerdo con sus necesidades. Esta separación evita duplicar textos y estructuras solo porque la web y una aplicación usan diseños diferentes.

question: Which method is recommended for managing AEM upgrades to minimize production disruptions?
answers: Perform direct upgrades in the production environment
Test upgrades in a staging environment first
Deploy upgrades during peak traffic hours
Implement upgrades manually across all instances
correct: Test upgrades in a staging environment first
reason: Probar primero la actualización en staging permite detectar incompatibilidades con contenido, código e integraciones antes de afectar a producción. La regresión debe cubrir los recorridos relevantes sobre una copia representativa. También hay que ensayar copias de seguridad, recuperación y tiempos de ejecución de la actualización.

question:
What factors should be considered when resolving implementation issues?
(Choose three)
answers: Business continuity
Security requirements
End-user adoption metrics
Time to resolution
User interface color schemes
correct: Business continuity
Security requirements
Time to resolution
reason: Priorizar incidencias exige valorar su impacto en la continuidad del negocio, la seguridad y el tiempo necesario para recuperar el servicio. Un fallo que expone datos o bloquea operaciones críticas suele preceder a un defecto menor de presentación. La prioridad debe basarse en impacto y urgencia comprobables, no solo en el orden de llegada.

question:
What are best practices for diagnosing issues in a production environment?
(Choose three)
answers: Enable detailed logging for troubleshooting
Test the issue in staging environments
Rebuild the content repository
Monitor system health metrics
Notify all end-users immediately
correct: Enable detailed logging for troubleshooting
Test the issue in staging environments
Monitor system health metrics
reason: El diagnóstico combina logs enfocados en el área afectada, reproducción controlada y métricas de salud. Esta combinación permite relacionar una operación concreta con su consumo y sus errores. Activar debug global durante periodos largos puede generar ruido, ocupar disco y afectar al rendimiento; conviene ajustar el alcance y retirarlo al terminar.

question: A client has three AEM environments: PROD, STAGE, and DEV. PROD and STAGE have more authoring activities such as content creations and updates compared to DEV. Disk space and performance are major requirements for the client. Which maintenance activity should the Architect recommend on the DEV environment?
answers: Revision Cleanup with the estimation phase disabled
Enable Day CQ WCM Version Purge Task
Revision Cleanup with the estimation phase enabled
Delete all "tar.bak" files from the SegmentStore folder
correct: Enable Day CQ WCM Version Purge Task
reason: Revisión de la clave: Version Purge elimina versiones de contenido antiguas, mientras Revision Cleanup recupera espacio de revisiones del almacenamiento TarMK. La menor actividad de DEV hace especialmente relevante mantener la fase de estimación, que evita compactaciones innecesarias si apenas hay basura recuperable. El enunciado no aporta una acumulación de versiones que justifique elegir Version Purge como única respuesta.

question: A customer wants to present a store front using AEM and Magento e-commerce platform. Refer to the following requirements: They use a third-party PIM System They want to use Adobe recommendations and utilize an OOTB solution in building this integration. While designing and documenting this solution, how should an Architect explain information relating to products and catalogs?
answers: Product and Catalog information is consumed and stored in AEM through a scheduled import process from the third-party PIM System that only updates the changes
Product and Catalog information is consumed and stored into AEM through a scheduled import process from Magento that only updates the changes
Product and Catalog information is consumed and stored into AEM through a scheduled import process from Magento that updates the whole catalog with every import
Products and Catalogs information is dynamically consumed from Magento, rendered on page, and cached on dispatcher
correct: Product and Catalog information is consumed and stored into AEM through a scheduled import process from Magento that only updates the changes
reason: Revisión de la clave: con la integración moderna CIF, AEM consulta dinámicamente los productos de Adobe Commerce/Magento y utiliza sus API como fuente del catálogo. La importación periódica del catálogo a JCR pertenece a otros patrones, incluido el comercio clásico. Para el enfoque moderno descrito, la opción de consumo dinámico es más defendible que la importación incremental marcada.

question: During the discovery phase of a new global banks AEM platform implementation, an Architect adds a non-functional requirement. The delivery of content for an Asian and a South American country must be delivered from local servers where no other content is allowed to be stored. The setup for website delivery must be redundant. The bank is operating globally and wants to have an excellent editing experience for the editors, who all work from the bank's main office in London. All form-based data will be leveraging a front end integration. Which architecture approach should the Architect use to meet the business requirements?
answers: Replication leveraging path-based ACLs dedicated replication agents for each publisher.
Replication agents using the default replication agent setup.
Replication agents replicating content to all Publish instances asynchronously.
Replication leveraging authentication and dedicated replication agents.
correct: Replication leveraging authentication and dedicated replication agents.
reason: Revisión de la clave: la residencia exigida requiere publicar en cada país únicamente sus rutas autorizadas, mantener redundancia local y situar Author cerca de los editores de Londres. Autenticar agentes no restringe por sí solo qué contenido se replica. Deben existir destinos y permisos de replicación limitados por ruta; una CDN global tampoco garantiza que las copias permanezcan solo en el país permitido.

question: A popular News portal site wants to move from their custom CMS to AEM On Premise. The client is on a limited budget and is only able to purchase the 1 Author 2 Publish Production license. The client cannot afford a CDN until the site can generate enough revenue. The client also has the following requirements: Migrate about two billion content pages and assets A site that is available at all times (even if the content is slightly stale) An improved search function that can do relevance tuning and faceted search The website needs to behave like a desktop application News authors write content once; the content can then be reused multiple times in different channels Which approach should an Architect recommend to meet these requirements?
answers: Implement AEM with SPA support and set up an Oak JCR Property index
Implement AEM with static and dynamic pages and set up an embedded Solr server
Implement AEM with SPA support and set up a remote Solr server
Implement AEM with static and dynamic pages and use the Lucene engine
correct: Implement AEM with SPA support and set up a remote Solr server
reason: Una SPA responde al comportamiento interactivo de aplicación de escritorio. Un Solr remoto permite separar la carga de búsqueda, ofrecer facetas y ajustar relevancia sin ejecutar ese motor dentro de AEM. Con un volumen de miles de millones de elementos, esta elección sigue necesitando dimensionamiento y pruebas: la licencia de dos Publish no demuestra por sí sola que se cumplan capacidad y disponibilidad.

question: A customer has the following setup of their digital platform: There are three types of business users: Marketers who use Adobe Target to drive personalization on the website Site editors working with AEM Asset editors who manage assets in an external DAM The marketers currently spend a lot of time uploading content and assets directly in Adobe Target. The customer wants to improve this process. What should the Architect recommend to the customer?
answers: Use Experience Fragments in AEM for targeted offers
Use Content Fragments and export them as JSON using Content Services
Configure the replication agent in AEM to replicate content to Target
Let the marketers use ContextHub Personalization in AEM
correct: Configure the replication agent in AEM to replicate content to Target
reason: Revisión de la clave: el mecanismo adecuado es crear Experience Fragments en AEM y exportarlos como ofertas a Adobe Target mediante su integración. Así los editores mantienen las experiencias y los especialistas de marketing las utilizan en actividades. Un agente de replicación genérico no sustituye la integración de exportación a Target.

images.alt: Current platform connecting marketers, site editors, asset editors, AEM, Adobe Target and an external DAM.

question: A financial customer wants to set up AEM on premise. The customer has a strong security requirement that traffic to the technical consoles in AEM (Web Console) must be encrypted. The solution should support secured server-to-server communications and be automated so it can be easily rolled out to a new AEM environment. Which solution should an Architect implement to meet the security requirements?
answers: Place a reverse proxy with SSL in front of the AEM instances
Set up a VPN tunnel to the AEM environment subnet
Use the Dispatchers and configure SSL to connect to the AEM instances
Connect directly to AEM instances with the SSL by default configured
correct: Connect directly to AEM instances with the SSL by default configured
reason: SSL by Default permite configurar HTTPS en AEM con certificado y clave en el almacén del servicio correspondiente. El procedimiento puede automatizarse para reproducir la configuración entre entornos y cifrar conexiones directas de servidor a servidor. Los clientes deben confiar en la cadena de certificados; habilitar HTTPS no sustituye la autenticación ni los permisos de las consolas.

question: An AEM customer has a website presence in different countries and in multiple languages. In their organization, a central editor team creates part of the content for all countries. Each country has a local editor team that manages the content of the specific country website. The customer has the following requirements: The centrally managed content needs to be pushed to the countries The local editors are responsible to translate the content in their local language The local editors need to be able to overwrite content that is pushed from the central team How should an Architect design the content hierarchy?
answers: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
correct: Option A
reason: La jerarquía debe combinar live copies para distribuir contenido central a los países y copias de idioma para las traducciones locales. Los equipos locales pueden gestionar sus traducciones y cancelar la herencia de propiedades o componentes que necesiten adaptar. La opción A representa ese reparto de responsabilidades; el rollout debe respetar las reglas de herencia y las excepciones locales.

question: A large retail customer is building their ecommerce platform on AEM. Several third-party vendors sell products through their site. Those vendors need to review and verify the content close to production before the content goes live and the customer wants to provide them a restricted environment. Which approach should the Architect recommend?
answers: Export content as PDF and share with the vendors
Give third-party vendors access to the Author Server
Add a Publish (preview) Server and provide access
Use the Preview Capabilities of AEM Author Server
correct: Add a Publish (preview) Server and provide access
reason: Un Publish de previsualización ofrece una experiencia próxima a producción sin hacer público el contenido definitivo. Permite restringir el acceso de los proveedores al material que deben revisar y evita darles funciones editoriales innecesarias. Deben configurarse autenticación, permisos y un flujo de publicación separado para ese entorno.

question: A customer has a website with 10,000 pages and wants to improve performance. Which option should be used?
answers: Specify a wildcard allow rule in the invalidate section
Advise to use URL parameters instead of sling selectors
Decrease .stat file level from the default
Increase .stat file level from the default
correct: Increase .stat file level from the default
reason: Un statfileslevel más profundo permite invalidar ramas más concretas del árbol de caché cuando cambia el contenido. Esto puede evitar que una publicación invalide indirectamente miles de páginas no relacionadas. El valor adecuado depende de la jerarquía del sitio y de sus dependencias; aumentarlo sin analizar esa estructura puede dejar contenido relacionado sin actualizar.

question: A website built on AEM Sites 6.5 Managed Service enables browser caching of JavaScript and CSS resources to optimize page load times. After the caching is enabled, QA testers notice that newly delivered components are missing styling, even hours after their deployment. Further analysis identifies outdated CSS files in the browser cache as the root cause. How should an Architect resolve this issue?
answers: Reduce the time-to-live of the browser cache to 5 minutes
Request the team to clear browser cache after deployments
Append per request randomized suffix to JavaScript and CSS URLs
Deliver ClientLibs with a content-based hash in the URL
correct: Deliver ClientLibs with a content-based hash in the URL
reason: Un hash basado en el contenido cambia la URL de la client library cuando cambian sus bytes. El navegador solicita entonces la nueva versión, mientras puede conservar durante mucho tiempo las versiones que no cambian. Un sufijo aleatorio por solicitud destruye la reutilización de caché, y pedir a los usuarios que la borren no es una solución de despliegue.

question: An AEM client wants to improve the performance of their site and take advantage of the dispatcher's caching ability for both page and component levels. The client wants to optimize the caching of static components and make sure dynamic components are rendered properly. Which approach should an Architect recommend to meet these requirements?
answers: Use Sling Dynamic Include (SDI) together with mod_proxy
Increase Dispatcher content cache TTL
Avoid nesting many levels of paragraph system components
Use Sling Dynamic Include (SDI) with server-side include tag
correct: Use Sling Dynamic Include (SDI) with server-side include tag
reason: Sling Dynamic Include puede sustituir un componente dinámico por una instrucción SSI que Apache resuelve al entregar la página. El resto de la página permanece cacheado en Dispatcher, mientras el fragmento se obtiene con la frecuencia apropiada. Hay que configurar correctamente SSI, las rutas incluidas y las reglas que impiden cachear como compartido contenido privado.

question: A news agency editor wants to publish news articles to an intermediate Publish (preview) instance for internal review before publishing the article to production Publish instance. Which two steps should the Architect recommend? (Choose two.)
answers: Create a custom publish workflow
Create a separate live copy to preview content
Create a reverse replication agent on preview server
Create a closed user group (CUG) for editors
Set up a new replication agent for preview server
correct: Create a custom publish workflow
Set up a new replication agent for preview server
reason: Un agente de replicación dedicado dirige el contenido al Publish de preview. Un workflow controla la secuencia de envío, revisión y posterior publicación en producción. No hace falta duplicar editorialmente el sitio como live copy para disponer de ese destino; sí proteger el acceso a preview y separar claramente las acciones de publicación.

question: An enterprise client is on-boarding an AEM Desktop application to provide authors with the ability to load the AEM repository virtually on the file system. The desktop application is unable to connect to the AEM Author, which has SSL enabled. The intermediate certificate is installed on Apache. How should an Architect resolve this issue?
answers: Install the certificate chain to the keystore of the AEM authentication service user
Install the Root certificate to the AEM truststore
Install the certificate chain to the AEM truststore
Install the certificate chain to the keystore of the AEM ssl-service user
correct: Install the certificate chain to the keystore of the AEM ssl-service user
reason: Si la aplicación se conecta directamente al HTTPS de AEM, ese servidor debe presentar una cadena completa desde el keystore de ssl-service. Instalar el certificado intermedio solo en Apache no corrige la cadena presentada por AEM. Si TLS termina realmente en Apache, hay que corregir la cadena de Apache: lo decisivo es qué extremo HTTPS está usando el cliente.

question: Refer to the exhibit. A client acquired AEM recently and is working with an Architect to define the templates that need to be created in AEM to migrate their legacy site. The page layouts of the legacy are in the above exhibit. Which template strategy should the Architect use?
answers: One static template with layout containers and components
One editable template with layout containers and components
One editable template with layout containers, 2 static templates and components
Three editable templates with layout containers and components
correct: One editable template with layout containers and components
reason: Una plantilla editable con contenedores de diseño y componentes puede soportar distintas composiciones sin crear una plantilla por cada distribución visual. Las políticas limitan los componentes y opciones que necesitan los autores. Esta estrategia es apropiada cuando los diseños del ejemplo comparten estructura funcional y sus diferencias pueden expresarse mediante composición y layout.

images.alt: Six legacy page layouts with different arrangements of headers, columns and content areas.

question: An AEM customer has the following high-level business goals: Deliver content on single-page apps Deliver content on mobile apps Deliver content to third-party applications A content delivery mechanism that adds the least amount of code to the codebase but does not unnecessarily expose data is required. What should an Architect use to meet these requirements?
answers: Sling Default JSON Renderer
Replication agents to deliver content
Custom Servlets to deliver content
AEM content services default renderers
correct: AEM content services default renderers
reason: AEM Content Services permite exponer representaciones definidas de componentes y páginas para aplicaciones externas aprovechando exportadores existentes. Evita escribir un servlet por cada necesidad y permite controlar qué datos se entregan. El renderizador JSON genérico del repositorio no representa automáticamente un contrato de API seguro y limitado al contenido necesario.

question: In a client's test environment, AEM QA Testers from multiple groups and regions are testing and making requests to the AEM application. Due to the sheer number of hosts making connections, an Architect needs a quick and easy way to allow any hosts to make requests to the AEM application. Which approach should the Architect take to meet this requirement for this non-production environment?
answers: Use Allowlists instead of Blocklists in the Dispatcher Configuration
Restrict Clients that can flush the cache in the Dispatcher Configuration
Enable Allow Empty in the Apache Sling Referrer OSGi Configuration
Add GET as a Filter Method in the Apache Sling Referrer OSGi Configuration
correct: Enable Allow Empty in the Apache Sling Referrer OSGi Configuration
reason: Revisión de la clave: Allow Empty permite aceptar solicitudes sin cabecera Referer; no autoriza cualquier valor de Referer ni cualquier host. Las solicitudes con esa cabecera siguen sujetas a la validación configurada. Por tanto, la opción solo resolvería el caso de clientes que no la envían, y no satisface literalmente el requisito de permitir todos los hosts.

question: A client is in the discovery process for building a React native app, which is a single codebase that runs natively on iOS and Android. The goal is to reduce development costs. The client wants to reduce content creation costs in the new react Native app by reusing as much of the marketing content already published in their AEM instance. What should the Architect recommend to meet this requirement?
answers: Experience Fragments
OSGi Bundles
Sling Resource Resolution
Content Fragments
correct: Content Fragments
reason: Los Content Fragments permiten reutilizar textos y datos estructurados sin acoplarlos al HTML del sitio. La aplicación React Native puede consumir ese contenido y renderizarlo con componentes nativos de iOS y Android. Un Experience Fragment conserva una composición de experiencia web, que no suele ser el formato adecuado para construir una interfaz nativa.

question: A client is setting up AEM 6.5 on premise. The client has been looking at different deployment models to help horizontally scale their Author and Publish instances. Which approach should an Architect recommend?
answers: Run a TarMK Farm on Author and an Oak Cluster with MongoMK on the Publish instances
Run a single TarMK instance on the Author and a TarMK Farm for Publish instances
Run an Oak Cluster with MongoMK instance on the Author and a TarMK Farm for the Publish instances
Run an Oak Cluster with MongoMK on both Author and Publish instances
correct: Run an Oak Cluster with MongoMK on both Author and Publish instances
reason: Revisión de la clave: para escalar Author horizontalmente, la arquitectura aplicable es un clúster Oak con MongoMK cuando está justificado por la carga. Para Publish, la recomendación habitual es una granja TarMK con instancias independientes y balanceadas. La opción que combina MongoMK en Author y TarMK en Publish es más adecuada que MongoMK en ambos niveles.

question: A client is doing a complete systemic upgrade of their old AEM site and moving to AEM 6.5 On-Premise. The new site will have the same content but completely new code. The client also has the following requirements for the new AEM instance: They want all users, groups, and ACLs migrated They do not want the version storage migrated They want all orphaned versions to remain in the old AEM site What migration approach should the Architect recommend to meet their requirements?
answers: Use the AEM User Admin and Package Manager
Use the AEM Content Transfer Tool
Use the CRX2Oak Migration Tool
Use the AEM Pattern Detector Tool
correct: Use the CRX2Oak Migration Tool
reason: CRX2Oak permite migrar el repositorio y configurar el tratamiento del historial de versiones y de las versiones huérfanas. Esto permite trasladar contenido, usuarios, grupos y permisos al nuevo entorno sin arrastrar el historial excluido. Pattern Detector identifica incompatibilidades, pero no realiza la transferencia; Content Transfer Tool responde principalmente al proceso de migración a Cloud Service.

question: A popular news portal customer migrates their website to Adobe Experience Cloud with AEM Sites and Analytics. The customer wants the homepage to support a load and render time of under 2 seconds for first-time visitors. Which two measures should an Architect apply to design for this requirement? (Choose two.)
answers: Load single images and apply responsive scaling in browser
Load all client libraries with content-based hash in the URL
Configure max-age=2000 for all JS and CSS resources
Use a CDN supporting HTTP/2 for all AEM resources
Configure Launch library to load asynchronously
correct: Load single images and apply responsive scaling in browser
Configure Launch library to load asynchronously
reason: Revisión de la clave: cargar la biblioteca de Launch de forma asíncrona evita bloquear el renderizado inicial. Sin embargo, descargar una imagen grande y reducirla con CSS no reduce sus bytes ni mejora especialmente la primera visita. Entre las opciones, una CDN con HTTP/2 junto con la carga asíncrona es más defendible; deben servirse también imágenes ajustadas al tamaño real.

question: A customer is using an on-premises version of AEM 6.5 and wants to migrate to AEM as a Cloud Service. The website that is running on AEM has a component that allows visitors to submit product ratings. These rating are stored on the AEM Publishers and consolidated on the AEM Author. Which action should an architect take when migrating to AEM as a Cloud Service?
answers: Recommend using JCR Storage Resource Provider to store the ratings
Set up reverse replication agents to transfer the ratings to the Author
Refactor the rating component to store its data beneath /apps and configure Sling Distribution
Refactor the rating component to use an external data store
correct: Refactor the rating component to use an external data store
reason: Las valoraciones son datos generados por visitantes y necesitan persistencia independiente de las instancias Publish de Cloud Service. Un almacén externo permite compartirlas y conservarlas durante reemplazos y escalados. Guardarlas en /apps es incompatible con su carácter inmutable, y la replicación inversa no es el patrón apropiado para esta migración.

question: An AEM Sites implementation is migrating from on-premise to AEM as a Cloud Service. Previously, the application was deployed in a single package for both code and access policy nodes. After initial deployment and testing in the new infrastructure, it is reported that user permissions are not working as expected. What change should the Architect make to address this issue?
answers: Move access policy nodes to a dedicated package and install manually
Update package metadata to use MergePreserve for handling access policy nodes
Document permissions and request the Customer Success Engineer to configure
Refactor access policy nodes to Apache Sling JCR Repoinit scripts in the same package
correct: Update package metadata to use MergePreserve for handling access policy nodes
reason: Revisión de la clave: en Cloud Service conviene declarar usuarios de servicio y permisos mediante scripts RepoInit y respetar la separación entre contenido mutable e inmutable. Esto hace la configuración reproducible durante los despliegues. Cambiar únicamente el modo de tratamiento de ACL a MergePreserve no resuelve necesariamente las restricciones del paquete ni garantiza una configuración consistente.

question: An Architect is designing a new platform that will be hosted on-premise. AEM 6.5 will be used and the customer will leverage AEM Sites and Assets on the same installation. When gathering potential usage data, the Architect notices that the client will make heavy use of asset ingestion. The content editors need the assets to be available for immediate use upon upload. The Architect needs to make sure editors are unhindered by workflows related to asset ingestion during regular content editing work. Which action should the Architect take to meet this requirement?
answers: Turn off asset workflows while ingesting assets
Ingest assets directly on the dispatcher
Process the assets using Adobe Assets on Demand
Leverage Offloading based on Apache Sling Discovery
correct: Turn off asset workflows while ingesting assets
reason: Revisión de la clave: desactivar los workflows evita procesamiento, pero también puede dejar los assets sin metadatos o renditions necesarios para utilizarlos. El offloading basado en Apache Sling Discovery permite trasladar tareas pesadas y reducir su impacto sobre la edición en esta arquitectura on-premise. Hay que mantener el procesamiento indispensable y medir el tiempo hasta que el asset queda disponible.

question: A customer's photo gallery site uses query parameters to filter photo search results. The site experiences high AEM Publish server load when users filter photos on the site. The customer would like to identify the cause of this issue. What should the Architect investigate first?
answers: Dispatcher load balancing configuration
