Volume of assets being loaded at a time
ignoreUrlParams configuration in dispatcher.any
Cache-Control Headers in dispatcher.any
correct: ignoreUrlParams configuration in dispatcher.any
reason: Los parámetros de consulta pueden hacer que Dispatcher no reutilice la caché y que cada filtro llegue a Publish. Revisar ignoreUrlParams permite comprobar si ese comportamiento explica la carga. Los parámetros que cambian realmente los resultados de búsqueda no deben ignorarse indiscriminadamente, porque se podría devolver a distintos filtros la misma respuesta cacheada.

question: A company with various departments wants to use tagging to improve search capability. Each department is restricted to use its own tags. How should an Architect organize the tags?
answers: Create a namespace for each department
Use department ID as a prefix of each tag
Create tags in "departmentName:tagName" format
Create a department sub-tag in each tag
correct: Create a namespace for each department
reason: Un namespace por departamento proporciona una raíz clara para organizar sus etiquetas y aplicar permisos. Las ACL deben permitir a cada grupo utilizar o gestionar los namespaces autorizados. Añadir un prefijo al nombre ayuda a reconocer una etiqueta, pero no establece aislamiento ni control de acceso por sí mismo.

question: During development the AEM Publisher server keeps crashing randomly. The deployment included a new static FAQ component that was used in the websites Contact Us page. An Architect investigates to find the root cause for the random failures, and notices the following parameters: The server slows down when requests are sent to the Contact us page The number of requests to the page were very few Heap dump shows a large number of instances of the FAQ component What is likely causing this issue?
answers: The JVM garbage collection is not running
The page was not cached in the Dispatcher.
The component has a cyclic dependency to itself
The component triggers a traversal query.
correct: The component has a cyclic dependency to itself
reason: Una dependencia cíclica puede hacer que el componente se instancie o se incluya recursivamente hasta consumir memoria, incluso con pocas solicitudes. La concentración de instancias del FAQ en el heap y la relación con esa página apuntan a esa causa. Hay que revisar inclusiones, adaptaciones y referencias recursivas, y confirmar el ciclo con trazas o dumps.

question: A large enterprise client is implementing their website in AEM. One of the requirements is to allow third-party cloud-based systems to retrieve images from the AEM Author instance. The client's security requirements prevent any solution that involves the transmission of sensitive data such as passwords being shared to external parties. The connecting third-party systems use dynamic IPs. How should an Architect proceed to safely expose API endpoints on AEM to external systems?
answers: Use OOTB AEM SAML Handler
Use IP-Range Whitelisting on the Web Application Firewall (WAF)
Use AEM Basic Authentication
Use the OAuth server in AEM with JWT tokens
correct: Use the OAuth server in AEM with JWT tokens
reason: La autenticación basada en tokens evita entregar una contraseña de usuario a cada consumidor y permite limitar alcance y vigencia. Es más adecuada que una allowlist de IP cuando los clientes cambian de dirección. La opción OAuth/JWT debe concretarse con un flujo soportado por la versión de AEM; los tokens y las claves de firma siguen siendo credenciales que requieren protección.

question: A client's site does not show the latest page content for some site visitors. The client has two data centers with each configured with a Dispatcher connected to two Publish machines. The site load issue only occurs intermittently for visitors from one of the data centers. Which step should the Architect take to resolve the issue?
answers: Disable caching on all impacted data centers Dispatchers to force the Publish machines to serve the page content
Review the log files on the Author instances to determine if there are any template errors
Check the Publish instance(s) attached to the Dispatcher associated to the impacted datacenter
Check the SSL certificate on the impacted data center's load balancer
correct: Check the Publish instance(s) attached to the Dispatcher associated to the impacted datacenter
reason: Si el problema es intermitente y se limita a un centro de datos, alguna instancia Publish de ese grupo puede tener contenido desactualizado. Hay que comparar las respuestas de sus instancias y revisar la replicación antes de atribuir todo el problema a Dispatcher. Un balanceador puede alternar entre una instancia correcta y otra atrasada, produciendo exactamente ese síntoma.

question: A customer with a static website uses a agency to centrally manage its content. The website is targeted for a international audience as shown in following diagram: Which model should the Architect recommend to improve performance?
answers: Publish to and cache content in the CDN
Load balance three AEM publishers
Deploy an author-publisher pair in each region
Use Adobe Target to deliver content in each region
correct: Publish to and cache content in the CDN
reason: Una CDN entrega copias cacheadas cerca de los visitantes y reduce las solicitudes al único Publish disponible. Es especialmente útil para contenido público y estático distribuido globalmente. No sustituye el origen ni su redundancia: AEM publica el contenido y la CDN lo obtiene, lo conserva y lo actualiza según la política de caché.

images.alt: Agency authors use one AEM Author and one AEM Publish to serve visitors in EMEA, APAC and AMER.

question: A client is moving from AEM 6.5 to AEM as a Cloud Service. Refer to the following client parameters and requirements: The client has five tenant projects that currently maintain separate git repositories The client has their own CI/CD pipeline that sends out notifications to their current team chat tool on success/failure and they want to keep this functionality The client expects to not reuse code across tenants The client wants to reuse assets across tenants Which solution should an Architect recommend?
answers: 1. Create a Cloud Manager program for each of the tenant's git repositories 2. Use Adobe I/O Events to send notifications via webhooks
1. Set up a single git repository with a multi-module maven project inside the Adobe git with each tenant project being a module 2. Use Adobe I/O Events to send notifications via webhooks

1. Set up a single git repository with a multi-module maven project inside the Adobe git with each tenant project being a module 2. Customize pipeline to include push notifications via the Cloud Manager UI
1. Set up a git repository for each tenant in the Adobe git repository 2. Customize pipeline to include push notifications via the Cloud Manager UI
correct: 1. Set up a single git repository with a multi-module maven project inside the Adobe git with each tenant project being a module 2. Use Adobe I/O Events to send notifications via webhooks
reason: Un proyecto Maven con un módulo por tenant permite compilar y desplegar los cinco proyectos en el entorno donde comparten assets, manteniendo separado su código. Adobe I/O Events puede notificar resultados de los pipelines mediante webhooks hacia la herramienta de chat. Esta organización no obliga a reutilizar código entre tenants; sí requiere coordinar el despliegue y las dependencias de cada módulo.

question: An Architect is analyzing a complex AEM Dispatcher configuration in preparation for a migration to AEM as Cloud Service. What two activities should the Architect perform to ensure a successful migration? (Choose two.)
answers: Use AEM Cloud Service Dispatcher Converter tool
Reduce the cache TTL to leverage the capabilities of Fastly in Cloud Service
Disable TTL based caching of resources on the Dispatcher
Ensure that the setup is only using supported Apache modules and directives
Minimize the number of rewrites and redirects in the httpd.conf files
correct: Use AEM Cloud Service Dispatcher Converter tool
Ensure that the setup is only using supported Apache modules and directives
reason: Dispatcher Converter ayuda a adaptar configuraciones existentes al formato requerido por Cloud Service. Después hay que revisar que las directivas y módulos de Apache utilizados estén admitidos y validar el resultado con las herramientas del SDK. Convertir archivos no garantiza que todas las reglas tengan el mismo efecto en la nueva plataforma.

question: A client's marketing pages are generally slow to load which is causing a significant drop in sales. All other AEM pages load within expected performance guidelines regardless of whether the visitor is being served the desktop or mobile experiences. The marketing pages typically get slower when multiple external campaigns such as Facebook and AdWords drive traffic to those pages. The page performance tends to dip during high traffic periods. Internal campaign clicks such as those from hero images use similar campaign codes as external campaign traffic. What should the Architect do to resolve this issue?
answers: Add a new dispatcher farm to assist with the clients marketing pages
Set AEM to use GZIP compression instead of the web server's compression
Modify the dispatcher.any file's section to ignore campaign-based URL parameters
Convert the marketing pages to a responsive design instead of an adaptive design
correct: Modify the dispatcher.any file's section to ignore campaign-based URL parameters
reason: Los parámetros de campañas que solo sirven para atribución no deberían forzar un renderizado nuevo de la misma página. Configurarlos en ignoreUrlParams permite aprovechar la caché de Dispatcher. Deben conservarse las excepciones para parámetros que modifiquen contenido, permisos o comportamiento funcional.

question: A large corporation is in the process of setting up a new Intranet based on AEM with the following parameters and requirements: Approximately 100,000 employees will use the system Business divisions maintain their own content Groups for business divisions are synced using SAML Groups for business divisions often change during reorganizations; no code change must be necessary to support this The authors should be able to grant permissions for everybody or for employees of certain business divisions What should an Architect recommend to set up Closed User Groups correctly? (Choose two.)
answers: Create a custom tab in page properties for authoring of permissions
Use permission-sensitive caching in Dispatcher
Use session management in Dispatcher
Define the content structure wisely to ensure regular ACLs and CUG entries do not interfere
Set ACLs for groups on author to hide non-relevant groups
correct: Use session management in Dispatcher
Define the content structure wisely to ensure regular ACLs and CUG entries do not interfere
reason: La jerarquía debe permitir que los autores asignen CUG a grupos y que esas restricciones no entren en conflicto con las ACL normales. Matiz de versión: en el esquema clásico de CUG, session management desactiva la caché de la granja. Si se necesita reutilizar contenido protegido en caché, debe evaluarse permission-sensitive caching, que comprueba autorización antes de entregarlo; no basta con activar la gestión de sesiones.

question: An AEM client is looking at enabling cross-language search and discovery automatically across all their AEM content, both Assets and Pages. The client wants to allow their authors to perform searches for content in AEM using non-English terms, to match the assets in AEM that have equivalent English terms on them. They would like to support French and Spanish and reduce the need for manual content translation. which two actions should an Architect take when developing a PoC to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
answers: Ensure that a new index is created for smart translation search
Set up Smart Translation Search
Set up a Translation Service Provider
Set up Translator to Manage Dictionaries
Ensure that enough memory is available
correct: Set up Smart Translation Search
Ensure that enough memory is available
reason: Revisión de la clave: Smart Translation Search pretende encontrar contenido a partir de términos equivalentes en otros idiomas, sin traducir manualmente cada página o asset. Disponer de memoria suficiente es una condición operativa, pero no demuestra que sea el segundo requisito específico de esta función. La configuración y el indexado deben verificarse para la versión del producto utilizada; la combinación marcada queda pendiente de validación técnica.

question: A large automotive customer wants to migrate their car configurator to the new AEM platform. Refer to the following customer requirements: The solution needs to integrate with an existing, already highly customized PIM There are approximately 20 base models with many configuration options for each There are over a million configuration combinations and there are rules on which configuration options can be applied together For each base model, there will be a content section with editable marketing content and an own section that shows the car configurator Content sections of base models are sometimes moved or copied by authors What two approaches should an Architect recommend for a maintainable solution? (Choose two.)
answers: Connect page trees on AEM side with a base model in PIM saving the content path as property of a base model PIM side
Connect page trees on AEM side with a base model in PIM using a model id property in JCR
Synchronize deltas from PIM nightly into the AEM repository and implement the rules in AEM
Synchronize deltas from the PIM nightly into the AEM repository and keep all rules in PIM
Integrate with the PIM system via REST services and keep all rules on PIM side
correct: Connect page trees on AEM side with a base model in PIM using a model id property in JCR
Integrate with the PIM system via REST services and keep all rules on PIM side
reason: Mantener el identificador del producto en AEM y consultar las reglas mediante una API conserva al PIM como fuente de verdad. Un identificador estable resiste mejor cambios de ubicación del contenido que una ruta usada como identidad. La integración debe controlar latencia, fallos y caché para que una consulta al PIM no bloquee innecesariamente toda la página.

question: An Architect needs to integrate a spell checker REST service into the authoring UI. The spell checker service is provided by a third party as a ready-made solution and does not send any Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers. The author dispatcher's Content Security Policy (CSP) headers are currently set to only allow self. Which integration approach should the Architect use?
answers: Implement a custom proxy servlet in AEM backend that adds the correct Origin header
Add the spell checker's base URL to the connect-src property of CSP response header
Use mod_proxy to route the spell checker requests from browser through origin server
Ensure the Javascript in browser adds the Origin header to the cross-origin request
correct: Use mod_proxy to route the spell checker requests from browser through origin server
reason: Un proxy del lado servidor puede presentar el corrector bajo el mismo origen que el sitio y reenviar las solicitudes al servicio externo. Esto evita depender de que el navegador pueda llamar directamente a un origen no admitido por CORS o CSP. El proxy debe limitar destinos y operaciones, validar entradas y gestionar credenciales; no debe convertirse en un proxy abierto.

question: A large grocery chain wants to implement an omnichannel shopping list experience in its AEM 6.5 instance. Any changes in the shopping list should be synchronized across experiences. Content Authors should be able to create recipes based on available items so customers can add them in bulk easily to the shopping list, The product data comes from a back-end system, like an ERP. The customer wants to upgrade to AEM as Cloud Service in the future, and the solution must not require drastic changes. Which solution should an Architect use to meet these requirements?
answers: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
correct: Option B
reason: La arquitectura debe separar el contenido editorial de AEM del estado transaccional, como listas de compra y operaciones de comercio. Un servicio especializado puede conservar ese estado y compartirlo entre canales. La opción B representa esa separación y evita depender de escrituras locales en Publish para información que debe seguir disponible al escalar o migrar a Cloud Service.

question: An Architect is designing an AEM platform for site delivery. Due to legal requirements, an Architect can not use a CDN for caching purposes. The changes to the sites must be immediately visible. The content structure uses a simple setup with a site folder and a language folder beneath. Approximately one activation for a site per 10 minutes is expected. The solution should ensure caching for all of the sites is high and that changes are quickly visible. Which approach should an Architect use to meet these requirements?
answers: Limit the activations of changes to 1 every 5 hours and disable refetching
Set the statfile level to 2 or higher in the dispatcher and use refetching
Configure the statfile level to 1 or lower for refetching in the dispatcher
Deploy the dispatcher and publish instances on a single server and configure refetching
correct: Set the statfile level to 2 or higher in the dispatcher and use refetching
reason: Un statfileslevel de 2 puede localizar la invalidación en ramas equivalentes a sitio e idioma si la jerarquía tiene esa estructura. El refetch permite volver a poblar la caché después del cambio, reduciendo el coste de la primera visita. El valor debe validarse con las rutas reales y con las dependencias entre páginas, no aplicarse como regla universal.

question: A customer wants to simplify and automate publishing press release pages and defines the following flow: What should the Architect recommend?
answers: Create a custom workflow
Configure MSM with the "Activate on Blueprint activation" option
Implement a Sling event listener that triggers on page creation
Advise the customer to use Launches
correct: Advise the customer to use Launches
reason: Revisión de la clave: Launches permite preparar y promover contenido futuro, pero no implementa por sí solo una aprobación financiera con decisiones y participantes. Ese requisito necesita un workflow que controle aprobaciones, condiciones y acciones de rollout o publicación. Launches puede participar en la solución si también existe planificación temporal, pero no reemplaza el flujo de aprobación.

images.alt: Create press release page; request approval for financial results, then roll out to live copies and publish.

question: A customer is migrating from their On-Premises AEM 6.4 instances to AEM as a Cloud Service. Next to the required code refactoring, a content migration of approximately 100,000 pages needs to be performed. The customer wants the content freeze period to be limited so that editors can continue to do content actions as long as possible. Which two recommendations should the Architect make for the migration of the content pages? (Choose two.)
answers: Migrate the content using the Content Transfer Tool
Migrate the content using Lazy Content Migration approach
Migrate content deltas using a query-based packaging tool
Upscale the memory of the On-Premise AEM instance
Ensure sufficient storage space on the On-Premise AEM instance
correct: Migrate the content using the Content Transfer Tool
Ensure sufficient storage space on the On-Premise AEM instance
reason: Content Transfer Tool permite transferir contenido hacia Cloud Service y realizar cargas incrementales o top-ups después de la carga inicial. Así se reduce la cantidad pendiente durante el corte final. El origen necesita suficiente espacio temporal y debe prepararse y verificarse; el tiempo de transferencia depende del volumen y de la conectividad.

question: A retail customer with an international presence and both in-store and online sales needs a new assets platform. The customer decides to use AEM assets. The customer's sites will continue to run on their proprietary CMS for websites. The customer wants to be able to scale the platform for spikes in user traffic such as on local sales or online marketing campaigns. Under some circumstances, the customer also has a higher load of editors for a certain period of time. Which architecture should an Architect use for this business case?
answers: An AEM as a Cloud Service Assets setup using the combined CDN for delivery
An AEM Publish instance on Adobe Managed Services with auto scaling
An AEM as a Cloud Service Sites with Dynamic Media
An AEM Assets setup on Adobe Managed Services with Cloud Manager
correct: An AEM as a Cloud Service Assets setup using the combined CDN for delivery
reason: AEM Assets como servicio gestionado permite centralizar los assets y ofrecer capacidades de procesamiento y entrega sin administrar toda la infraestructura. Una CDN reduce latencia y carga cuando los consumidores externos solicitan recursos publicables. Deben definirse las API y productos de entrega contratados: almacenar un asset en Author no lo convierte automáticamente en un recurso público servido por CDN.

question: A client is migrating the content from a legacy website to an existing AEM implementation. An Architect evaluates the content of the legacy site and determines that there are approximately 20,000 pages with a common structure, and a few hundred pages that do not follow a pattern. The client wants to complete the migration as soon as possible. Which approach should the Architect recommend for the content migration?
answers: Migrate all common pages using the ETL procedure with multiple rounds
Recreate the entire content manually with a group of Content Authors
Migrate all common pages using the ETL procedure and use manual authoring for the rest
Use Site importer to import the content into AEM
correct: Migrate all common pages using the ETL procedure and use manual authoring for the rest
reason: Un proceso ETL resulta adecuado para migrar grandes cantidades de contenido con estructura repetible: extrae, transforma y carga aplicando reglas uniformes. El contenido excepcional o escaso puede requerir adaptación manual. Antes de ejecutar toda la migración hay que probar una muestra representativa y validar campos, enlaces y assets en destino.

question: Refer to the exhibit. A customer has SSO on its AEM Author environment using Adobe IMS, which is integrated with the customer's IDP using SAML. The customer plans to roll out a new secured website on AEM where sso authentication is required for end users. The end user accounts are also managed in the customer's existing IDP. How should the Architect set up the authentication for the website?
answers: Integrate AEM Publisher using SAML directly with the IDP
Set up CUG and use User Synchronisation from Author to Publisher
Integrate AEM Publisher using SAML with Adobe IMS
Integrate AEM Publisher using OAuth with Adobe IMS
correct: Integrate AEM Publisher using SAML with Adobe IMS
reason: Revisión de la clave: Adobe IMS gestiona el acceso de usuarios de la organización a los servicios de Adobe, pero no es la solución general para autenticar visitantes externos de un sitio. Para esos usuarios, Publish puede integrarse directamente con el proveedor de identidad mediante SAML. Deben distinguirse las cuentas administrativas del acceso de clientes al sitio web.

images.alt: Current SSO architecture: AEM Author connects through Adobe IMS and SAML 2.0 to the identity provider.

question: A large digital agency has 10 TB of assets in their DAM where renditions for each Asset must be created without affecting performance for the authors. Which capability should the Architect recommend to meet the requirements?
answers: Use AEM Asset Offloading
Update dispatcher configuration to cache Assets
Create AEM multi-threaded workflow
Reduce the number of AEM Asset versions
correct: Use AEM Asset Offloading
reason: Procesar renditions de un DAM de gran tamaño consume recursos que también necesitan los autores. Trasladar ese procesamiento a infraestructura especializada permite aislar la carga y mantener la capacidad editorial. El diseño debe contemplar colas, concurrencia, recuperación de errores y disponibilidad de las variantes necesarias antes de publicar.

question: A client is modernizing some of their AEM sites to go from static to editable templates so they can use the latest features around styling and layouts. The client has the following parameters: The client currently has a dozen static templates that they want to move to editable templates. The existing pages use the parsys paragraph system for storing components. Each page based on one of the static templates has its own custom properties tab that is unique for that template type. The client wants template authors to be able to create the editable templates. Which approach should an Architect use to meet these requirements?
answers:
1. Use a new page component for editable templates based on the core components page component
2. Migrate page properties to respective components dialogues

1. Use a new page component for editable templates based on the core components page component
2. Convert page properties to policies

1. Use the same page components for editable templates
2. Create a new editable template based on each of the existing page components

1. Use the same page components for editable templates
2. Use a new template type for each static template
correct:
1. Use a new page component for editable templates based on the core components page component
2. Migrate page properties to respective components dialogues
reason: Revisión de la clave: migrar de plantillas estáticas a editables exige adaptar estructura, políticas y componentes al nuevo modelo. Las propiedades personalizadas de página no tienen que convertirse obligatoriamente en componentes ni desaparecer. Puede reutilizarse o extenderse el componente de página; la estrategia depende de cómo se almacenan y consumen esas propiedades, por lo que la opción marcada no es una regla general.

question: AEM as a cloud service introduces major changes in the architecture by using containers. Which key architectural change was necessary to allow this to occur?
answers: Using sling content distribution as the replication mechanism
Isolating /app and /libs from the content, configurations and state mgmt.
Using Adobe IO for asset ingestion and processing,storing it on a separate blob and providing AEM with metadata
Using MongoDB for Author environment
correct: Using Adobe IO for asset ingestion and processing,storing it on a separate blob and providing AEM with metadata
reason: Revisión de la clave: una característica fundamental de Cloud Service es separar el código inmutable, como /apps y /libs, del contenido mutable. Esto permite desplegar y reemplazar instancias de forma reproducible. Adobe I/O puede intervenir en integraciones o procesamiento, pero no explica por sí solo la arquitectura de contenedores ni la separación entre aplicación y estado.

question: A client using AEM 6.5 on-premise is experiencing an unsustainable repository growth of 100Gb a day. After investigation, an Architect finds out that the DAM is causing this issue. Each image uploaded to the DAM triggers the creation of approximately 100 renditions, necessary by business to consume in different channels and systems. The client also complains about stale content reported by site visitors happening randomly in pages where article-related components are present. How should the Architect address these issues?
answers: Leverage AEM Adaptive Image Servlet, cache image variations in Dispatcher, and re-implement article-related components to use AJAX to load the content
Split WCM and DAM in separate instances, set up Connected Assets, and re-implement article-related components to use AJAX to load the content
Split WCM and DAM in separate instances, set up Connected Assets, and implement a workflow to purge all pages affected by an article change in Dispatcher
Leverage AEM Adaptive Image Servlet, cache image variations in Dispatcher, and implement a cache TTL in Dispatcher
correct: Split WCM and DAM in separate instances, set up Connected Assets, and implement a workflow to purge all pages affected by an article change in Dispatcher
reason: Separar Sites y Assets puede aislar el procesamiento del DAM, y un flujo de invalidación correcto evita servir artículos antiguos. Sin embargo, ninguna de esas medidas elimina por sí sola el almacenamiento excesivo de cien renditions por asset. Ese problema requiere revisar qué variantes se generan y considerar transformaciones bajo demanda; la respuesta marcada solo cubre parte del escenario.

question: A media company surveys the end users of their AEM Sites website. The survey identifies that it is difficult to locate content on the site due to lack of relevancy and slow performance when navigating through the large volume of content. To address both issues, the business team suggests integrating an innovative taxonomy product to the company's AEM implementation. The product is new on the market, and the development team has no experience with the technology. Which two steps should an Architect recommend to evaluate this new feature? (Choose two.)
answers: Test usability of the feature with selected business users
Develop the integration as proof of concept with full production content
Develop the integration and deploy it to 50% of the production AEM instances
Develop the integration as proof of concept with sample content
Test usability of the feature with selected end users
correct: Test usability of the feature with selected business users
Develop the integration as proof of concept with full production content
reason: Revisión de la clave: una prueba de concepto de taxonomía debe utilizar una muestra representativa y usuarios que realicen las búsquedas y tareas reales. Esto permite comparar encontrabilidad y usabilidad sin trasladar todo el contenido de producción. El volumen completo o desplegar parcialmente en producción no son requisitos previos para validar la propuesta.

question: Refer to the exhibit. A customer with an existing AEM implementation wants to enrich product pages with technical data coming from their PIM system. The PIM system sits behind an API Management solution that publicly exposes the PIM API's as RESTful web services with basic authentication as the security mechanism. Data consistency with the PIM and secure access to the APIs are key elements of the integration. How should the Architect set up the integration between AEM and the PIM?
answers: Import the technical data into the AEM Author and replicate to Publishers
Convert the technical data to Content Fragments and expose using Content Services
Use a client-side integration with AJAX from the browser to the API Management
Integrate the AEM Publishers directly with the API Management solution
correct: Integrate the AEM Publishers directly with the API Management solution
reason: Las credenciales de Basic Authentication deben permanecer en el servidor, por ejemplo en una integración entre Publish y una capa de gestión de API. El navegador consume una interfaz controlada sin recibir el secreto del PIM. HTTPS, permisos mínimos, límites de tiempo y caché ayudan a proteger y estabilizar esa dependencia.

images.alt: Current AEM infrastructure with two publishers, dispatchers and a load balancer, and a PIM behind API Management.

question: A customer wants to migrate their AEM environment from an on-premise infrastructure to a public cloud to improve performance. The customer currently hosts many assets (images, videos, documents) in the DAM. Approximately 10 business users frequently upload new assets and update existing assets. Editors then use these assets on the sites. What should an Architect do as part of this migration?
answers: Set up a horizontally scalable AEM environment on MongoDB
Set up Connected Assets to share the DAM assets in the sites
Move to a shared datastore and enable binary less replication
Run online revision cleanup before moving to the new storage format
correct: Run online revision cleanup before moving to the new storage format
reason: Matiz de la clave: la limpieza del repositorio puede reducir espacio ocupado y mejorar su mantenimiento, pero no demuestra por sí sola una mejora de transferencia de assets. Para cargas de binarios también hay que valorar un datastore compartido y replicación sin binarios cuando la topología lo permita. La palabra cloud no determina si se trata de Cloud Service o de AEM alojado en infraestructura propia.

question: An AEM customer is designing a new website. The design shows that images are very prominent on the website but there is a concern about the big variety of aspect ratios used. Images can potentially be used on different places and components on the website. The customer is looking for a maintainable solution to limit the amount of content editing work when adding the assets to the pages. Which solution should an Architect recommend?
answers: Integrate with Dynamic Media (Scene 7) and enable smart imaging
Integrate with Dynamic Media (Scene 7) and enable smart cropping
Use the cropping feature on the asset in the AEM DAM
Use inline cropping feature of the image component on the pages
correct: Integrate with Dynamic Media (Scene 7) and enable smart imaging
reason: Revisión de la clave: Smart Crop selecciona un recorte adecuado al punto de interés y a la relación de aspecto requerida. Smart Imaging optimiza la entrega de imágenes, por ejemplo su formato y peso, pero no sustituye ese recorte. Si el requisito es adaptar el encuadre entre formatos, la opción técnicamente pertinente es Smart Crop.

question: During an optimization session, a client using AEM 6.5 mentions that they face challenges with their AEM Author setup. The client has significant repository growth and can see an increased amount of TAR files in the segmentstore on disk. When editors are working, they see that workflows take up more time. The purging of workflows works as expected. Which two optimizations should an Architect suggest to look into and further investigate? (Choose two.)
answers: Leverage workflow offloading for all workflows
Increase the maxFileSize of the TAR segmentstore
Configure the Maximum Parallel Jobs
Leverage Transient Workflows where possible
Execute an offline tar compaction twice a day
correct: Configure the Maximum Parallel Jobs
Leverage Transient Workflows where possible
reason: Limitar los trabajos paralelos evita que los workflows de assets monopolicen CPU y memoria. Los workflows transitorios reducen la persistencia de historial y el coste de escritura cuando no se necesita conservar ese seguimiento. Deben utilizarse solo en procesos compatibles con esa falta de historial, sin eliminar trazabilidad que el negocio necesite.

question: An AEM Architect is moving existing content from an on-premise AEM to an AEM Cloud Service instance using the Content Transfer Tool. As part of the initial source preparation, the Architect is going to run the offline compaction on the on-premise AEM. What other two actions should the Architect do to the on-premise AEM before proceeding with the extraction phase? (Choose two.)
answers: Run datastore consistency check via oak-run
Verify that free disk space is at least 1.5x the JCR size
Validate that all replication agents are disabled
Verify that wipe mode is enabled
Stop all bundles using the AEM Web Console
correct: Run datastore consistency check via oak-run
Verify that free disk space is at least 1.5x the JCR size
reason: Comprobar la consistencia del datastore permite detectar referencias a binarios ausentes antes de transferir contenido. Además, la extracción necesita espacio libre para los datos temporales y los paquetes que produce. La cifra de capacidad indicada en la pregunta debe contrastarse con la versión de Content Transfer Tool y el volumen real; es una condición de preparación, no una garantía de éxito.

question: A customer is about to go live with a new website on AEM on prem. The DNS (www.domain.com) already points to the load balancer of the AEM environment and final sanity checks are being performed. The website was tested in lower environments without SSL. On production, the website is served over https. During sanity testing, all requests result in a 404. While investigating this issue, an Architect determines the following: The requests land on port 443 on the load balancer where SSL is terminated and an HTTP header X-Forwarded-Proto is set The website Sling Mapping is created beneath /etc/map/http/www.domain.com.80 The URLs on the website are externalized with http in the absolute links Which two actions should the Architect take to resolve this problem? (Choose two.)
answers: Ensure the Sling Mapping exist at /etc/map/https/www.domain.com.80
Ensure the Sling Mapping exist at /etc/map/http/www.domain.com.443
Configure the Adobe Granite SSL Connector Factory with the correct SSL port
Ensure the Sling Mapping exist at /etc/map/https/www.domain.com.443
Configure Apache Felix Http Service SSL Filter to use the correct SSL forward header
correct: Ensure the Sling Mapping exist at /etc/map/https/www.domain.com.80
Configure Apache Felix Http Service SSL Filter to use the correct SSL forward header
reason: Revisión de la clave: cuando TLS termina en el balanceador, AEM debe interpretar correctamente el esquema original mediante la información de proxy y el SSL Filter. Los mapas de Sling deben coincidir con el host y puerto efectivos de la solicitud. No puede asumirse que https.host.80 sea siempre correcto: hay que comprobar cabeceras, puerto externo y reglas de resolución para evitar enlaces o redirecciones erróneos.

question: A client has an existing AEM site using components that proxy AEM WCM Core Components. The site uses simple page authoring without referenced content. The client wants to create a new experience on another marketing channel. The plan is to use as much of the existing page content as possible to avoid refactoring the current content and to maintain consistency across channels. Which AEM capability should an Architect use to meet these requirements?
answers: Experience Fragments
Sling Model Exporter
Content Fragments
Assets API
correct: Experience Fragments
reason: Matiz de la clave: un Experience Fragment es apropiado para reutilizar una experiencia compuesta, especialmente si el consumidor necesita HTML. Si los canales necesitan datos JSON de componentes existentes, Sling Model Exporter puede ser una solución más directa. Sin especificar el formato requerido por los consumidores, no puede afirmarse que Experience Fragments sea siempre la mejor elección.

question: A media company wants to use AEM as content hub for multiple customer touch points: Brand-specific marketing websites hosted on AEM Sites Single Page Applications using headless content Native mobile applications Content offers in Adobe Target The company wants to manage its content efficiently with its small editor staff. Text should be entered and reviewed only once, then reused for all touch points. How should an Architect incorporate these requirements into a solution that leverages AEM Sites features?
answers: Option A
Option B
correct: Option A
reason: Los Content Fragments proporcionan contenido estructurado para aplicaciones y otros consumidores mediante servicios de entrega. Los Experience Fragments reúnen componentes y presentación para reutilizar experiencias, por ejemplo como ofertas en Target. El diagrama A distingue esos cometidos; no debe suponerse que un fragmento de experiencia genera automáticamente el modelo estructurado de un Content Fragment.

question: An AEM client requests that an Architect to establish non-functional KPIs. The Architect needs to avoid impacting user experience, asset processing, and download speed while doing this. How should the Architect measure the performance properly to establish target metrics?
answers: Use the Free Request Log Analyzer Command Line Tool
Use JMeter for end-to-end tests
Tail the Access Log and look for long-running queries
Use the OOTB Explain Query Tool
correct: Use the Free Request Log Analyzer Command Line Tool
reason: Request Log Analyzer permite analizar solicitudes registradas y construir una línea base de tiempos y patrones de uso. Es útil para identificar rutas lentas y decidir qué escenarios investigar. No genera carga por sí mismo: las pruebas de concurrencia requieren una herramienta que emita solicitudes representativas.

question: A company is implementing a new e-commerce site that is expected to get seasonal and flash-sale induced traffic peaks from all over the world. It is projected that a minute of downtime could cause excessive lost revenue. The company management wants to keep resource utilization to optimal levels without experiencing degradation to avoid introducing bugs in the system. The Architect needs to choose between AEM 6.5 and AEM as Cloud Service. What are the two most critical non-functional requirements the Architect must consider? (Choose two.)
answers: Usability
Scalability
Reliability
Maintainability
Availability
correct: Maintainability
Availability
reason: Revisión de la clave: absorber picos de tráfico exige escalabilidad, y evitar interrupciones exige disponibilidad. La mantenibilidad reduce el esfuerzo de operar y modificar el sistema, pero no describe directamente su capacidad para atender más carga. Para el escenario planteado, escalabilidad y disponibilidad son los requisitos no funcionales más directamente relacionados.

question: A user is part of the Employees LDAP group synchronized with AEM. The same user is added to the authors group in AEM. The user is then removed from the Employees group on the LDAP server. What is the result during the next synchronization with AEM?
answers: The user is removed from the authors group but not the Employees group in AEM
The user is removed from both the Employees and the AEM authors groups
The user is not removed from either the Employees and the AEM authors groups
The user is removed from the Employees group but not the authors group in AEM
correct: The user is removed from both the Employees and the AEM authors groups
reason: Revisión de la clave: al sincronizar pertenencias LDAP, AEM actualiza los grupos vinculados al proveedor externo, pero conserva las pertenencias a grupos locales. Quitar a una persona de un grupo en LDAP no implica eliminarla también de un grupo local de autores. La respuesta marcada mezcla ambos ámbitos y no representa el comportamiento documentado.

question: An existing AEM sites platform will receive the latest service pack. The service pack includes functional and non-functional fixes such as security patches Which action should the Architect take to make sure the update is successful?
answers: Install the service pack in staging and ensure that all the bundles are up and running. then deploy to production.
Identify the packages affected by the service pack after installing them into production and monitor them.
Advise the customer to request Adobe to install the fixes directly on production since they are prechecked.
Do a full staging of the service pack including a regression test, if passed, deploy to production.
correct: Install the service pack in staging and ensure that all the bundles are up and running. then deploy to production.
reason: Revisión de la clave: que los bundles estén activos después de una actualización solo confirma parte del arranque técnico. Debe ejecutarse una regresión completa de los recorridos críticos, las integraciones y la edición en staging. Una comprobación mínima puede dejar sin detectar incompatibilidades funcionales aunque todos los servicios OSGi parezcan iniciados.

question: A client is using AEM and wants to make sure they are managing their configurations correctly. Refer to the following requirements: The client has multiple brands that they will be hosting on a single AEM implementation The client wants to reuse as much between brands as possible Each brand needs to be able to override the default values for items like contact us information The client plans to support multiple languages in multiple regions for each brand Each brand/language/region combination will have its own set of content approvers used as part of a custom workflow Which approach should an Architect recommend to manage the client's configurations for AEM?
answers: Use OSGi to manage approval group and provide default contact us information by runmode.
Use Context-aware configurations to manage configuration overrides and approval group by brand/language/region combination.
Use the OOTB Configuration Browser to set configuration defaults and approval group by brand/language/region combination.
Use OSGi Configuration to handle configuration overrides by brand. Create a new workflow for each brand/language/region combination for content approval.
correct: Use Context-aware configurations to manage configuration overrides and approval group by brand/language/region combination.
reason: Context-Aware Configuration permite resolver valores según la posición del contenido en una jerarquía, por ejemplo marca, idioma y región. Los valores comunes se heredan y las ramas concretas pueden sobrescribirlos. Los run modes describen características del entorno de ejecución y no son una buena herramienta para representar cada variante de negocio del árbol de sitios.

question: A website built on AEM Sites displays the company's stock price in the footer of all pages. The stock data is retrieved from a third party REST service using two-way SSL and rendered in an AEM component using HTL, During performance testing in the last development sprint, it becomes apparent that the third party service sometimes takes up to 30 seconds to respond, which degrades the overall site performance. How should an Architect address this issue?
answers: Temporarily remove the component from all content
Add a 5 second timeout to the REST call
Load the stock data component asynchronously
Call the REST service directly from the browser
correct: Load the stock data component asynchronously
reason: Una llamada externa de treinta segundos no debe bloquear el renderizado principal de la página. Puede cargarse el dato de forma asíncrona a través de un servicio de backend que gestione mTLS, tiempos de espera y una respuesta de reserva. El certificado privado debe permanecer en el servidor; si el dato es stock, hay que definir cuánta antigüedad es aceptable.

question: A client designs a new experience for one of their brand sites with the following parameters: The new experience should behave like a desktop application There is a lot of dynamic content in the app SEO and initial page load are a top concern for the client The client's marketing team needs to be able to author the content with a WYSIWYG editor Which approach should the Architect use to meet these requirements?
answers: Create a set of API-driven components
Use the traditional server side components on the website
Use AEM as a headless CMS
Use the SPA Editor SDK with Server Side Rendering
correct: Use the SPA Editor SDK with Server Side Rendering
reason: En el enfoque de SPA Editor al que se refiere la pregunta, el renderizado del lado servidor permite entregar HTML inicial útil para indexación y primera visualización. La aplicación conserva después su interacción del lado cliente y su integración editorial. La elección debe comprobar compatibilidad y ciclo de vida del SDK; SSR también añade un servicio que hay que desplegar y monitorizar.

question: A large AEM enterprise site is implementing authentication and requires a true optimal load balancing across the site's multi AEM publish instances. Which approach should an Architect take to meet this requirement?
answers: Configure Sticky Connections
Enable Round Robin processing in Dispatcher configuration
Enable Encapsulated Token Option
Configure the Dispatcher to run with a Dedicated System User
correct: Enable Round Robin processing in Dispatcher configuration
reason: Revisión de la clave: Round Robin distribuye solicitudes, pero no elimina una dependencia de autenticación con una instancia concreta. Los encapsulated tokens permiten validar el estado de autenticación sin exigir afinidad de sesión por ese motivo. Por eso son la respuesta técnica relevante cuando se pretende combinar autenticación con un balanceo más flexible.

question: A financial sector client is using AEM 6.5 on premise. The creative team needs to create the content for the various marketing campaigns that are scheduled. The client wants to use Experience Fragments (XF) to accelerate content creation for marketing purposes. Which Data flow diagram should an Architect use to communicate requirements to the client network team?
answers: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
correct: Option A
reason: AEM Author prepara y exporta el Experience Fragment a Target como oferta. Los recursos que referencia deben estar publicados y ser accesibles desde AEM Publish o su capa de entrega para los visitantes. La opción A representa esa separación: exportar el HTML a Target no significa copiar automáticamente todos los assets al mismo destino.

question: Users report cases where data inaccuracies are present in an AEM component that relies on AEM Search functionality. The AEM platform utilizes Lucene as its main search engine. How should an Architect resolve this issue?
answers: Scale up server resources to meet demands
Change the search engine to Property Search
Migrate search engine to an external Solr instance
Add search indexes to Lucene search engine
correct: Change the search engine to Property Search
reason: Los índices Lucene asíncronos pueden tardar en reflejar cambios recientes, lo que explica resultados temporalmente atrasados. Para determinadas consultas por propiedades que requieren consistencia inmediata, un índice de propiedades puede ser adecuado. Hay que revisar el tipo de consulta y el estado del indexado: no reemplaza de forma general todas las búsquedas de texto completo.

question: A customer wants to implement an AEM solution to serve localized content to several regional websites Which AEM capability should the Architect recommend?
answers: Use translation connector and i18N API
Use translation connector and translation workflows
Use translation connector and Multi Site Manager
Use i18N API and Multi Site Manager
correct: Use i18N API and Multi Site Manager
reason: Revisión de la clave: i18n traduce cadenas de interfaz de componentes mediante diccionarios, mientras MSM distribuye y sincroniza contenido entre sitios. La traducción de páginas y fragments requiere los procesos de traducción de contenido y, si corresponde, un proveedor integrado. La combinación marcada solo es suficiente si la localización solicitada se limita a interfaz y gestión de variantes.

question: A customer has a requirement to allow authors to access AEM with single sign-on. To achieve this an Architect needs to integrate AEM with the customer's identity management system. Which two actions could an Architect take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)
answers: Configure the generic SSO Authentication Handler
Configure the SAML Authentication Handler
Implement the generic SSO Authentication Handlerinterface
Configure the Sling Authentication Requirements for the OSGi HTTP Service
Implement a custom JAAS Login Module
correct: Configure the generic SSO Authentication Handler
Configure the SAML Authentication Handler
reason: AEM puede integrar SSO mediante un manejador SAML o mediante cabeceras de identidad emitidas por un sistema de confianza. En el segundo caso, el proxy debe eliminar cabeceras aportadas por el visitante y establecer únicamente las verificadas. LDAP aporta un directorio y validación de credenciales, pero su mera conexión no proporciona una sesión SSO del navegador.

question: An Architect needs to design a deployment process without downtime for end users. The system architecture contains an AEM author, two AEM publishers, two publish Dispatchers, and a centrally managed load balancer. The publishers serve some content that cannot be cached. Which two actions should the Architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
answers: Connect each publish Dispatcher to one AEM publish
Deploy software packages by replicating them from author to publishers
Use each publish Dispatcher to load-balance to both AEM publishers
Configure the centrally managed load balancer to connect directly to the AEM publisher that is not being deployed to
Deploy software package to AEM Publishers one by one
correct: Connect each publish Dispatcher to one AEM publish
Deploy software package to AEM Publishers one by one
reason: Un despliegue progresivo retira del balanceador una parte de las instancias, la actualiza y la reincorpora tras comprobar su salud. Las demás siguen atendiendo tráfico, siempre que tengan capacidad suficiente. La redundancia de Dispatcher y Publish debe acompañarse de compatibilidad entre versiones y cuidado con cambios compartidos que podrían afectar a todo el conjunto.

question: AEM Site users report that the web content pages render very slowly. An Architect notices that the CPU usages of the AEM Publish instances are spiking and reviews the following entry in the log: [Fri Nov 27 23:11:00 2019] [] [pid 16004 (tid 140134145820416] Current cache hit ratio: 47.94 % What should the Architect do to increase the dispatcher cache ratio and prevent the AEM Publish CPU usage spikes?
answers: Add additional dispatcher servers
Create a cron job that will delete the dispatcher cache on a regular basis
Review and optimize the Dispatcher cache configuration
Add additional AEM instances to the Publish Farm
correct: Review and optimize the Dispatcher cache configuration
reason: Una tasa de aciertos de caché del 47,94 % indica que muchas solicitudes alcanzan el origen y merece investigar las causas. Hay que revisar contenido cacheable, parámetros, cabeceras, cookies e invalidaciones frecuentes. Borrar la caché reduce inicialmente los aciertos; añadir hardware puede aumentar capacidad sin corregir el trabajo repetido.

question: A new AEM Sites implementation includes a component that lists the 10 most recently published PDF documents in AEM Assets. The component works as expected during development and passes QA testing. The business starts to use it while entering content and uploading assets in preparation for go-live. A few days later, the component's PDF list is empty. What is the most likely cause of the issue?
answers: The component is missing a matching Oak index.
The component is missing the HTL display context to escape the PDF title.
A PDF with incorrect MIME type has been uploaded.
A PDF with too large file size has been uploaded.
correct: The component is missing a matching Oak index.
reason: Una consulta que funciona con pocos documentos y falla al crecer el conjunto puede estar recorriendo el repositorio sin un índice adecuado. Hay que revisar el plan de ejecución, los logs de traversal y los límites alcanzados. Un problema de escape en HTL no suele depender del número de PDFs almacenados de esa manera.

question: A company is experiencing slow performance on their website which primarily processes user-submitted data, during higher volumes of traffic. The website is built on the latest version of on prem AEM. Which factor would an architect consider when assessing the current state of this architecture?
answers: The number of AEM authors
The number of items in the reverse replication queue
The number of concurrent users
The number of active workflows
correct: The number of concurrent users
reason: La concurrencia determina cuántas operaciones deben resolverse al mismo tiempo y puede saturar threads, conexiones o escrituras. Para entradas de usuario hay que medir tiempos bajo carga representativa y comprobar dónde esperan las solicitudes. El número total de usuarios registrados no equivale al número de usuarios activos simultáneamente.

question: A company is migrating their website to AEM and wants to use the platform's built-in personalization features to improve the user experience for their different target audiences. Which personalization strategy would the architect recommend to meet the company's requirements?
answers: Content-based personalization with AEM components
Behavior-based personalization with AEM ContextHub
Profile-based personalization with AEM user profiles
Data-driven personalization with Adobe Target
correct: Behavior-based personalization with AEM ContextHub
reason: ContextHub proporciona almacenes de datos del contexto y mecanismos de segmentación para personalización en AEM. Permite adaptar experiencias según información disponible del visitante y reglas definidas. Target ofrece capacidades adicionales mediante una integración propia; no es necesario confundir esa plataforma externa con la funcionalidad nativa que pide la pregunta.

question: A client is evaluating whether to deploy AEM as an on-premise or cloud-based solution. Which non-functional technical requirement would an architect consider when choosing between an on-premise or cloud-based deployment?
answers: Performance requirements
Maintenance and support costs
Software development kit (SDK) limitations
correct: Maintenance and support costs
reason: Revisión de la clave: los costes de mantenimiento son un criterio económico y operativo importante al comparar alojamiento. Sin embargo, si se pide un requisito no funcional técnico, el rendimiento es una categoría más directa y medible mediante latencia o capacidad. La clasificación del enunciado y la respuesta marcada no son plenamente coherentes.

question: A business wants to update its website to a new, modern look-and-feel to better engage customers. To achieve this, they have designed a site architecture that requires multiple assets for each page, such as structured data for SEO and user customization options. The business wants to use Adobe Experience Manager to manage all content and assets throughout the process. Which capability would an architect recommend to meet the requirement?
answers: Experience Fragments
Content Services
Content Fragments
Sites
correct: Content Fragments
reason: Los Content Fragments ayudan a modelar información estructurada que puede reutilizarse en distintas páginas y canales. Su contenido puede formar parte de una experiencia de AEM Sites optimizada para buscadores. El diseño de página, las URL, los metadatos y el renderizado indexable requieren configuración adicional: usar fragments no garantiza por sí solo SEO ni crea el layout.

question: A client wants to improve the performance of their AEM website by reducing server response times and improving cache efficiency. What should an architect do to meet the client's requirements?
answers: Utilize server-side include
Enable permission-sensitive caching in dispatcher
Implement a content delivery network (CDN)
correct: Implement a content delivery network (CDN)
reason: Una CDN reduce el tiempo de entrega cuando puede responder desde una caché próxima al visitante. También descarga al origen, lo que puede mejorar su capacidad para solicitudes que no se pueden cachear. Las respuestas dinámicas y los fallos de caché siguen dependiendo de AEM y sus integraciones, que deben optimizarse y medirse.

question: A client wants to improve the overall performance and scalability of their website on AEM. They are also concerned about maintaining a seamless experience for their global user base. What would an architect consider when designing the AEM infrastructure to meet these requirements?
answers: Optimization of media workflows in AEM
Integration with external analytics tools
Utilization of CDN for assets and content
Increase the CPU and memory capacity of AEM servers
correct: Utilization of CDN for assets and content
reason: Distribuir contenido mediante una CDN reduce el recorrido de red para audiencias geográficamente dispersas. Una herramienta de analítica ayuda a detectar problemas y medir resultados, pero no acelera directamente la entrega. La mejora depende de cachear los recursos adecuados y utilizar políticas de actualización coherentes.

question: A global retail company wants to revamp their existing digital presence. They have identified Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) as the ideal platform for content management and delivery. The company requires a highly performant website, especially during peak times such as holiday shopping and new product releases. They want the ability to easily scale to meet increased demand without sacrificing user experience and would like a low maintenance platform architecture along with a preference for low code implementation. Which approach would an AEM architect recommend to meet these requirements?
answers: Implementing AEM on Adobe Managed Services along with Cloud Manager for auto-scaling and faster DevOps pipelines
Implementing AEM as a Cloud Service to utilize auto-scaling and built-in content distribution
Using a CDN to distribute content and improve website speed during peak hours of operation
correct: Implementing AEM as a Cloud Service to utilize auto-scaling and built-in content distribution
reason: AEM as a Cloud Service aporta elasticidad y operación gestionada para responder a variaciones de demanda. Reduce el trabajo de administrar manualmente una infraestructura fija. La aplicación debe seguir siendo compatible con múltiples instancias y usar correctamente caché, consultas y servicios externos; la plataforma no vuelve eficiente cualquier implementación.

question: A company is redesigning their website and wants to enhance the user experience by personalizing content and offers based on customer behavior. They have implemented Adobe Analytics and Adobe Campaign, and now want to utilize ContextHub in its website implementation. The company has a high volume of website traffic and wants to ensure that ContextHub is scalable and can handle the large amounts of transactions. What is the most important functional requirement for the implementation of ContextHub in this scenario?
answers: Automation of personalized experiences triggered by ContextHub data
Personalization of content and offers based on customer behavior
Customizable data collection and segmentation capabilities
correct: Customizable data collection and segmentation capabilities
reason: Recoger datos del contexto y utilizarlos para decidir qué contenido mostrar describe una funcionalidad del sistema. ContextHub aporta mecanismos para almacenar ese contexto y evaluar segmentos. La escalabilidad describe cuánto uso puede soportar esa función, por lo que pertenece a los requisitos no funcionales.

question: A large corporation is currently utilizing on prem Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) for their various websites and online platforms. However, they now want to integrate Adobe Campaign into their system to better manage their marketing campaigns and customer engagement. The company has over a hundred million customers and deals with highly sensitive financial and personal data. They also have strict regulatory and compliance requirements. Furthermore, the marketing team is spread across different regions and they need to be able to effectively collaborate and share marketing assets. The current AEM architecture is implemented with a cluster of Author and Publisher instances, with a single AEM Dispatcher server configured with a webserver handling user access to Author and Publish instances. The company wants to ensure that the security of the system is not compromised and there are no performance bottlenecks when integrating with Adobe Campaign. What recommendation should an architect make to meet the company's requirements?
answers: Introduce a load balancer on top of the dispatcher to efficiently balance traffic between the publish instances
Utilize a content delivery network (CDN) to distribute and handle the increase in traffic
Allocate one dispatcher for each AEM instance and introduce a load balancer to distribute traffic efficiently between the dispatchers
correct: Allocate one dispatcher for each AEM instance and introduce a load balancer to distribute traffic efficiently between the dispatchers
reason: Un único Dispatcher constituye un punto de fallo aunque haya varios Publish detrás. Varias instancias de entrega y un balanceador con comprobaciones de salud permiten continuar atendiendo tráfico si una falla. El diseño también debe considerar la disponibilidad del propio balanceador; la relación exacta entre Dispatcher y Publish depende de la topología.

question: A national retail chain wants to track the effectiveness of their marketing campaigns on their AEM site. They want to analyze customer engagement and conversion rates on their landing pages. They also want their marketers to be able to make changes to tracking without involving developers. What is the best practice to incorporate this integration requirement into the solution design?
answers: Use the inbuilt reporting capabilities of Adobe Campaign
Configure Google Analytics on the landing pages
Use Adobe Data Collection to implement Adobe Analytics
correct: Use Adobe Data Collection to implement Adobe Analytics
reason: Una capa de datos expone eventos y valores de negocio de forma estable, y Tags permite configurar reglas para enviarlos a Analytics. Esto reduce el acoplamiento entre los selectores del HTML y la instrumentación de marketing. Los cambios de reglas deben conservar gobierno, pruebas y consentimiento cuando los datos lo requieran.

question: A client’s AEM instance needs to connect to a SQL database for retrieving sensitive user data. To ensure that the requests from AEM are secure, the client wants to restrict incoming requests to a specific IP address. However, the AEM as a Cloud Service instance is provisioned dynamically, meaning its IP address is not static. What recommended solution would an architect propose to ensure that outgoing requests from AEM as a Cloud Service are from a specific IP address that can be whitelisted in external systems such as SQL databases?
answers: Enable advanced networking via Cloud Manager APIs and configure an API gateway to manage and secure outgoing requests from the AEM instance
Enable advanced networking via Cloud Manager APIs and configure a dedicated egress IP address to securely connect AEM and the external systems
Enable advanced networking via Cloud Manager APIs and configure a virtual private network to securely connect AEM and the external systems
correct: Enable advanced networking via Cloud Manager APIs and configure a dedicated egress IP address to securely connect AEM and the external systems
reason: Una dirección de salida dedicada permite que un sistema externo autorice conexiones procedentes de una IP estable. En Cloud Service se configura mediante las capacidades de red avanzada apropiadas. Ese control de red no sustituye la autenticación de la API, el cifrado ni los permisos de las operaciones.

question: A healthcare organization has recently implemented AEM on premise using the standard settings and now has a large number of media assets that need to be quickly accessed and retrieved by their website visitors. The organization has been experiencing slow performance when attempting to load these assets, causing user frustration. The architect has been tasked with designing a solution that will improve the performance of the system when dealing with a large number of binaries. Which recommendation would the architect make to improve performance in this scenario?
answers: Utilize an external Data Store using File or Azure/S3 Data Store for storing media assets
Deploy a dedicated AEM instance for Assets and integrate to the AEM instance for Sites using Connected Assets
Increase the number of CPUs and Memory allocated to the AEM instances based on traffic
correct: Utilize an external Data Store using File or Azure/S3 Data Store for storing media assets
reason: Separar los binarios del almacenamiento de segmentos reduce la presión que los archivos grandes ejercen sobre el repositorio. Un datastore externo también puede facilitar compartir o gestionar esos binarios según la arquitectura. La velocidad de descarga depende además de red, caché y entrega; externalizar el almacenamiento no garantiza por sí solo menor latencia.

question: A company is planning to move their AEM implementation to AEM as a Cloud Service. As part of the migration, they want to ensure error pages are handled correctly. An architect is evaluating the current implementation and notices that the current error handling only shows a generic error page when a 5XX error is received from the backend. To improve user experience, the architect wants to make sure that the actual response from the backend is shown, along with specific error messaging. What is the recommended solution for error handling in AEM as a Cloud Service specifically for 5XX errors?
answers: Add the following header to the response: "x-aem-error-pass: true" to allow the actual response from the backend to pass through when a 5XX error is received
Configure AEM to pass through the actual response from the backend when a 5XX error is received and use a CDN to serve the error page
Use Apache/Dispatcher to handle errors and configure it to serve the actual response from the backend when a 5XX error is received
correct: Add the following header to the response: "x-aem-error-pass: true" to allow the actual response from the backend to pass through when a 5XX error is received
reason: La cabecera x-aem-error-pass: true permite que la CDN entregue una respuesta de error generada por el origen en lugar de sustituirla por su respuesta predeterminada. Es útil para conservar páginas de error personalizadas de AEM o Apache. No puede hacer llegar una página del origen cuando este no responde o el fallo ocurre antes de recibir su respuesta.

question: A digital company is planning to migrate their website containing about 45,000 pages along with supporting assets from AEM to AEM as a Cloud Service. The current environment consists of multiple projects and utilizes a mix of code and content within the same package. The company wants to minimize any disruptions to the live website during the migration and also would like a short content freeze period before the new website in AEM as a Cloud Service is live. What two migration strategies would an architect propose to the client that will help with fast tracking the migration? (Choose two)
answers: Utilize the Repository Modernizer utility to reorganize existing project packages into mutable and immutable content
Utilize AEM as a Cloud Service Migration Tool to convert existing packages into mutable and immutable content
Utilize the Content Transfer Tool to migrate all content followed by top-up extractions until go live
Utilize the Content Transfer Tool to migrate all content followed by installation of content packages in batches for differential content
correct: Utilize the Repository Modernizer utility to reorganize existing project packages into mutable and immutable content
Utilize the Content Transfer Tool to migrate all content followed by top-up extractions until go live
reason: Repository Modernizer ayuda a adaptar la estructura del proyecto, incluida la separación de paquetes apropiada para Cloud Service. Content Transfer Tool traslada el contenido y sus top-ups reducen los cambios pendientes antes del corte. Son tareas complementarias: modernizar el código no migra los datos, y transferir datos no corrige incompatibilidades de la aplicación.

question: A client is interested in implementing Experience Cloud Setup Automation to streamline and speed up the integration of their Experience Manager Sites with Analytics. They want to ensure that the setup will be user-friendly and will easily capture performance analytics for customer engagement and conversions without having to set up the integrations manually. What two requirements should an architect ensure are completed before initializing the Experience Cloud Setup Automation for integration to Adobe Analytics via the UI in AEMaaCS? (Choose two.)
answers: Ensure that the AEM Site is built using AEM Core Components
Ensure that an Adobe Analytics configuration is created in AEM
Ensure that an Adobe Launch Cloud Service configuration is created in AEM
Ensure that the Adobe Client Data Layer is enabled
correct: Ensure that the AEM Site is built using AEM Core Components
Ensure that the Adobe Client Data Layer is enabled
reason: En la automatización histórica descrita por la pregunta, los Core Components y Adobe Client Data Layer aportan los eventos y datos que necesita la configuración de Analytics. Esto evita instrumentar desde cero cada componente. Esa automatización figura actualmente como obsoleta en la documentación, por lo que debe distinguirse la respuesta del temario de la solución que se elegiría para una implantación nueva.

question:
A large e-commerce company is launching a new website on AEM as a Cloud Service and is seeking recommendations for performance testing. The website contains dynamic content, personalized recommendations, and has the following requirements: 
- To handle a peak of 100,000 concurrent users 
- An average page load time of under 3 seconds 
- 99.9% uptime according to SLA 
- Real-time inventory and pricing updates The company currently has six AEM instances in their Author Environment and six AEM instances in their Publish Environment. The architect designing a performance testing plan for the e-commerce website and needs to consider multiple types of testing. Which type of testing would help ensure that the website meets the requirements?
answers: Scalability testing to insure that AEM instances scale up during high traffic volumes
Load testing to simulate the expected peak traffic and validate SLA uptime requirement
Integration testing to insure all real-time API integrations are performant under heavy loads
Unit testing to verify that individual components and features are performing as expected
correct: Load testing to simulate the expected peak traffic and validate SLA uptime requirement
reason: Las pruebas de carga simulan el pico esperado y permiten medir latencia, errores y capacidad con muchos usuarios concurrentes. Son necesarias para comprobar que la solución soporta la demanda prevista. Una ejecución breve no demuestra un SLA anual del 99,9 %: la disponibilidad requiere además redundancia, pruebas de fallo, recuperación y seguimiento operativo.

question: A growing e-commerce company is using AEM on prem as its CMS for managing its website. With an increase in traffic and sales, the company is experiencing performance issues during peak times, resulting in slow website response times and occasional website downtime. The current architecture consists of one AEM author instance, one AEM publish instance. The company’s team of developers has identified the need for a more scalable and resilient architecture to meet the increasing demands and ensure uninterrupted performance for their customers. Which architectural change should the company implement to address the performance issues during peak times and provide a more scalable and resilient solution long-term?
answers: Implement a Content Delivery Network (CDN) for improved caching and load balancing
Migrate the AEM environment to a cloud-based hosting platform
Increase the hardware resources of the existing AEM publish instance
correct: Migrate the AEM environment to a cloud-based hosting platform
reason: Migrar a una plataforma cloud puede facilitar una arquitectura elástica y redundante para los picos de comercio. La mejora requiere configurar varias instancias, balanceo, caché y mecanismos de recuperación apropiados. Trasladar sin cambios un único Author y un único Publish a máquinas virtuales no elimina por sí solo sus puntos de fallo.

question: A client is planning to migrate their on-premise AEM deployment to AEM as a Cloud Service. They have a DevOps process that involves code reviews by peers in a GUI based GIT repository, and do not want to change their established workflow. The client wants to ensure that their new deployment can still support this process without causing any disruptions. What solution would the architect recommend to ensure the client’s DevOps processes can continue as-is in their migration to AEM as a Cloud Service?
answers: Retain the code and the code review process in the existing GIT repository and utilise Adobe I/O to directly trigger Cloud Manager pipelines for deployments
Retain the code review process in the existing GIT repository and create a new pipeline to sync the required branches to the Adobe Managed GIT repository
Migrate the code review process to Cloud Manager and Adobe Managed GIT repository
correct: Retain the code review process in the existing GIT repository and create a new pipeline to sync the required branches to the Adobe Managed GIT repository
reason: Mantener las revisiones en el repositorio habitual y sincronizar las ramas aprobadas con el repositorio que usa Cloud Manager conserva el flujo de trabajo del equipo. La sincronización debe garantizar qué commit se despliega y cómo se resuelven divergencias. Esta respuesta corresponde al flujo descrito; otras opciones de conexión de repositorios dependen de las capacidades disponibles en Cloud Manager.

question: A company has an existing AEM site that is integrated with their CRM platform to personalize content for logged-in users. They are now looking to integrate with their marketing automation platform to further enhance their personalization efforts. The marketing automation platform requires data to be passed in real-time as users navigate the site. The client also wants to ensure that the integration is scalable and can handle high volumes of traffic. Which solution would an architect recommend to meet these requirements?
answers: Develop a custom integration between AEM and the marketing automation platform using webhooks
Integrate AEM with Adobe Campaign and Adobe Target to process personalized marketing automation
Create a data layer to capture user data and use Adobe Launch to send it to the marketing automation platform
Implement a custom API to send user data to the marketing automation platform in real-time
correct: Create a data layer to capture user data and use Adobe Launch to send it to the marketing automation platform
reason: Una capa de datos recoge eventos de navegación y valores de negocio con un contrato estable. Tags puede enviarlos a la plataforma de automatización mediante reglas, evitando acoplar cada componente a una API distinta. Deben limitarse los datos enviados, respetar el consentimiento y evitar exponer secretos o información sensible del CRM en el navegador.

question: A company is experiencing a slow response time along with random execution errors on their website powered by AEM during form submissions. After conducting performance tests, the developers have discovered that the filter chain is not functioning as desired.
