The current configuration for the filter chain is as follows: 25000 : class com.adobe.granite.csrf.impl.CSRFFilter; 10000 : class com.adobe.resourceresolverhelper.impl.ResourceResolverHelperImpl; 30000 : class com.wknd.core.filters.FormSubmissionFilter; Based on the service.ranking property value, what would be the ideal way to arrange the order of the filter chain to resolve the issues faced given that 30000, 10000 and 25000 are current the service.ranking values for the respective filters?
answers: 20000 : class com.wknd.core.filters.FormSubmissionFilter; 30000 : class com.adobe.granite.resourceresolverhelper.impl.ResourceResolverHelperImpl; 25000 : class com.adobe.granite.csrf.impl.CSRFFilter;
25000 : class com.wknd.core.filters.FormSubmissionFilter; 20000 : class com.adobe.granite.resourceresolverhelper.impl.ResourceResolverHelperImpl; 30000 : class com.adobe.granite.csrf.impl.CSRFFilter;
25000 : class com.adobe.granite.csrf.impl.CSRFFilter; 20000 : class com.adobe.granite.resourceresolverhelper.impl.ResourceResolverHelperImpl; 30000 : class com.wknd.core.filters.FormSubmissionFilter;
correct: 25000 : class com.wknd.core.filters.FormSubmissionFilter; 20000 : class com.adobe.granite.resourceresolverhelper.impl.ResourceResolverHelperImpl; 30000 : class com.adobe.granite.csrf.impl.CSRFFilter;
reason: Revisión de la clave: los filtros Sling se ejecutan de mayor a menor service.ranking. La clave marcada ejecutaría CSRF, después el filtro de formulario y finalmente ResourceResolverHelper. Si el filtro de formulario depende del contexto preparado por este último, seguiría estando mal ordenado; la opción que coloca primero el resolver y después CSRF antes del formulario es más defendible. El orden debe basarse en dependencias comprobadas.

question: During the launch of an e-commerce website implemented with AEM Sites and Adobe Commerce, a timeout issue has been observed frequently resulting in unstable web page loads. This occurs shortly after users try adding several products to their carts. After inspecting the logs, an Architect finds the log message: “java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded.” Further investigation shows that auto garbage collection is turned off in production and the instance’s JVM parameters are set with minimum heap size of 1024 mb and maximum heap size of 2048 mb. What would the architect do to ensure the issue does not occur in future deployments?
answers: Increase the JVM heap size to at least 4096 mb
Increase the JVM maximum heap size to 2048 mb
Increase the JVM minimum and maximum heap sizes to at least 1024 mb
Enable Garbage Collection in production
correct: Enable Garbage Collection in production
reason: Revisión de la clave: GC overhead limit exceeded indica que la JVM dedica casi todo su tiempo a recolectar y apenas recupera memoria. Por tanto, contradice la afirmación de que el recolector está desactivado y no se resuelve simplemente habilitándolo. Hay que estudiar heap dumps, objetos retenidos y dimensionamiento; ampliar memoria solo ayuda si la demanda es legítima y no existe una fuga.

question: A multinational company is using AEM as a Cloud Service for their global website. Recently, they received complaints from users in different. Regions that the website is loading slowly. After investigating, the architect noticed that the website images are taking a long time to load and the server response time is high. The company´s marketing department has requested that the website´s performance be improved. What is likely causing the website to load slowly?
answers: The website is utilizing third-party services that area acusing slow loading times.
The website´s content is stored in multiple AEM repositories.
The website´s pages contain a large number of components.
The website is not utilizing a content delivery network (CDN) to distribute the website´s content.
correct: The website is not utilizing a content delivery network (CDN) to distribute the website´s content.
reason: Revisión de la clave: AEM as a Cloud Service incluye una CDN, por lo que no puede deducirse su ausencia únicamente a partir de imágenes lentas. Hay que comprobar que las solicitudes utilizan la ruta de entrega prevista, qué respuestas son cacheables y el tamaño de las imágenes. También deben medirse el origen y las integraciones antes de atribuir toda la latencia a una sola causa.

question: A large retail company is implementing their new e-commerce website using AEM Sites, with a target audience of international customers. One of their requeriments is to support multiple languages for all site content. Which approach would an architect recommend to ensure the site supports multiple languages?
answers: Utilize the built-in AEM language translation feature
Use AEM Translation integration with third-party translation services
Use a machine learning algorithm to automatically translate content
correct: Use AEM Translation integration with third-party translation services
reason: El framework de integración de traducción conecta AEM con proveedores que traducen el contenido dentro de un proceso gestionado. Permite organizar proyectos, enviar material y recibir traducciones para las copias de idioma. No debe confundirse con los diccionarios i18n de la interfaz, ni suponerse que AEM traduce automáticamente todo el sitio sin configurar un servicio.

question: A marketing team is implementing a new e-commerce site on AEM, using React as the front-end framework. They have encountered some performance issues and the architect has recommended prototyping with the headless e-commerce solution provided by Adobe Commerce. The team is now reviewing the different options for implementing this prototype in AEM. What is the most effective method for prototyping the headless e-commerce solution in AEM?
answers: Using a headless solution using third-party APIs
Utilizing AEM's built-in headless capabilities
Creating a custom e-commerce solution in AEM
correct: Utilizing AEM's built-in headless capabilities
reason: Aprovechar las capacidades headless de AEM permite prototipar la entrega de contenido a React sin construir un CMS alternativo. Las operaciones comerciales deben integrarse con las API de Adobe Commerce y los mecanismos CIF que correspondan. Los Content Fragments organizan contenido, pero no implementan por sí solos catálogo transaccional, carrito ni checkout.

question: A client is implementing a new AEM site with custom code for an interactive media experience. During testing, users are reporting issues with the custom code causing slowdowns and crashes on certain pages. The code was developed by a third-party agency and the client's development team is struggling to understand the underlying issue. In order to troubleshoot the issue, the client requests an in-depth analysis of the code and its potential interactions with AEM's core components. After reviewing the code and conducting further testing, the client's development team finds that the third-party agency had included several custom components that are not optimized for AEM's performance standards. These components are causing frequent server crashes and excessive load times, negatively impacting the user experience. What is the most likely solution to resolve the performance issues caused by the custom components?
answers: Rebuild the custom components using AEM's core components for optimal performance
Hire additional developers to fix the code and improve its performance issues
Increase server memory and processing power to accommodate the code's demands
Disable the custom components and restructure the site design to avoid using them
correct: Rebuild the custom components using AEM's core components for optimal performance
reason: Rehacer los componentes problemáticos apoyándose en Core Components reduce código propio y permite reutilizar patrones compatibles con AEM. Antes hay que identificar consultas, bucles, retención de objetos o llamadas que provocan la degradación. La sustitución debe verificarse con el escenario que fallaba: heredar de un Core Component no garantiza por sí solo que toda personalización sea eficiente.

question:
A company is developing a new e-commerce website using AEM as a Cloud Service. The site is heavily reliant on images and videos to showcase products, and the team has been utilizing AEM's image and video manipulation capabilities to optimize file sizes and loading times. During implementation, it is reported that the website is loading extremely slowly and customers are experiencing crashes when attempting to view product galleries. An architect investigates the issue and notices the following parameters: 
- CPU usage is consistently at 90% 
- Heap dump shows a large number of instances of the image object 
- Reviewing the website's network activity, the majority of the time is spent loading images and videos What is the likely cause of the performance issue?
answers: The website has too much content, causing the server to slow down.
The adaptive image servlet configuration is not set up properly.
Images and videos are not being properly cached by the Dispatcher.
correct: Images and videos are not being properly cached by the Dispatcher.
reason: Si cada petición vuelve a procesar o recuperar imágenes y vídeos, la falta de caché puede generar alto consumo de CPU, memoria y tiempos de entrega. Revisar cabeceras, reglas y aciertos de caché permite comprobar esa hipótesis. Los síntomas también requieren analizar las transformaciones y el tamaño de los recursos; no prueban por sí solos que Dispatcher sea la única causa.

question: A company has implemented AEM as a Cloud Service and wants to use its integrated Mail Service to send emails to their customers. However, the company has a strict security policy and requires all outgoing emails to be sent using OAuth2 authentication. Currently, the AEM instance is configured to use SMTP to send emails with a company-owned email server. What should the company do to adhere to their security policy while utilizing AEM's Mail Service?
answers: Create a new OSGI service to implement support for OAuth2 authentication and update the Day CQ Mail Service configuration to enable OAuth2 flow
Create a new CQ Mailer SMTP OAuth2 Provider configuration for the mail provider and update the Day CQ Mail Service configuration to enable OAuth2 flow
Create a new OSGI service to implement support for OAuth2 authentication and extend the Day CQ Mail Service to add support for SMTP via OAuth2 authentication
correct: Create a new CQ Mailer SMTP OAuth2 Provider configuration for the mail provider and update the Day CQ Mail Service configuration to enable OAuth2 flow
reason: El proveedor CQ Mailer SMTP OAuth2 configura la obtención de tokens para el servicio de correo, y Day CQ Mail Service debe habilitar ese flujo. OAuth2 cambia el mecanismo de autenticación; el envío puede seguir usando SMTP. Hay que configurar permisos, renovación de tokens y secretos de forma segura, sin desarrollar un servicio nuevo si la capacidad existente cubre al proveedor.

question: A company has recently upgraded to AEM as a Cloud Service and is experiencing issues with their Dispatcher configuration. Some of the redirects are not working as expected and the architect is trying to analyze if the mode of the dispatcher is to blame. What are the differences between the dispatcher modes that an architect can use to decide which to use?
answers: In flexible mode, there are no restrictions on the number of rewrite rules that can be added, while legacy mode limits the number of rewrite rules that can be added to rewrite.rules
In flexible mode, there are no restrictions on the file structure under the rewrites folder, while legacy mode limits the number of rules that can be added
Legacy mode involves adding the folder and file opt- in/USE_SOURCES_DIRECTLY, while flexible mode does not require any additional configurations
correct: In flexible mode, there are no restrictions on the number of rewrite rules that can be added, while legacy mode limits the number of rewrite rules that can be added to rewrite.rules
reason: Revisión de la clave: el modo flexible permite organizar y utilizar directamente la configuración de rewrites con mayor libertad. El modo legacy restringe su estructura y establece un límite de tamaño del conjunto de archivos personalizados; no se define simplemente por un número máximo de reglas. USE_SOURCES_DIRECTLY habilita el enfoque flexible, por lo que la explicación de la opción marcada es una simplificación imprecisa.

question: A company is updating their website with a new design and needs to create a new subscription form using AEM. What is the recommended approach an architect would take?
answers: Enable AEM Forms and develop a new custom subscription form
Utilize the AEM Core Components to create a custom form with minimal coding
Create a new HTML form using Adobe Target and inject it on the page
correct: Utilize the AEM Core Components to create a custom form with minimal coding
reason: Para una suscripción sencilla, los componentes de formulario de Core Components permiten componer campos y envío con poco código propio. Hay que implementar o configurar la acción que valida y registra la suscripción. AEM Forms puede resultar apropiado para procesos más complejos, pero no es imprescindible solo por necesitar un formulario básico.

question: A company has implemented the Style System on their AEM website to provide a variety of visual styles for a specific component. However, after the implementation, the developers noticed that the styles were not being displayed on the page when the component was edited by a content author. They suspect that there may be an issue with the component's content policy. What should the developers check to resolve the issue?
answers: The design_dialog node for the specific component
The template's design_dialog node for the specific component
The content policy of the component for any missing or incorrect style classes
correct: The content policy of the component for any missing or incorrect style classes
reason: El Style System relaciona opciones editoriales con clases CSS declaradas en la política del componente. Si esas clases faltan o son incorrectas, la selección del autor no producirá el estilo esperado. También hay que comprobar que la plantilla aplica esa política y que la client library que define las clases se carga en la página.

question: A digital media company relies heavily on the latest version of AEM to manage and deliver high-quality content to their website visitors. Their design team uploads hundreds of assets to the AEM DAM on a daily basis. Recently, the performance of the authoring environment has significantly decreased and the authors have noticed a delay in loading assets and editing pages. After investigating the logs, an architect notices that there are multiple instances of duplicate assets, which is causing an increase in processing time and affecting the performance of the environment. What would the architect recommend to diagnose and resolve this performance issue?
answers: Enable the feature for detecting duplicate assets via the Day CQ DAM Create Asset configuration.
Update the DAM Update Asset Workflow to enable duplicate detection in the Gate Keeper process step
Update the DAM Update Asset Workflow to enable duplicate detection with a new custom Workflow Process Step
correct: Enable the feature for detecting duplicate assets via the Day CQ DAM Create Asset configuration.
reason: La detección de duplicados en Day CQ DAM Create Asset permite advertir sobre nuevas cargas de assets ya existentes. Es una medida de gobierno que evita acumular más copias innecesarias. No elimina automáticamente los duplicados anteriores ni demuestra que sean la única causa de lentitud; estos deben revisarse junto con los workflows y la carga de procesamiento.

question: A client has an e-commerce website hosted on AEM with a large number of users making frequent purchases. However, the client is experiencing slow performance and long page load times which is negatively impacting their sales and user experience. The client wants to implement a solution for caching and secure access to different pages on their website for authorized users and specific user groups. The AEM architect decides to use permission-sensitive caching in Dispatcher along with updates to deny filters that limit access to certain pages for unauthorized users and groups. How does the permission-sensitive caching in Dispatcher help optimize the client's website performance while still maintaining security for different user groups and access restrictions?
answers: It only caches pages that do not require authorization.
It utilizes the Auth Checker Servlet module to bypass the security checks for cached pages.
It checks the user's permissions before delivering the cached content.
correct: It checks the user's permissions before delivering the cached content.
reason: Permission-sensitive caching consulta un comprobador de autorización antes de entregar contenido protegido desde la caché. Así puede reutilizarse una representación compartida sin dar acceso a quien no tiene permisos. No omite la seguridad, y no debe emplearse para compartir respuestas personalizadas que contienen datos distintos para cada usuario.

question:
A popular fashion blog site built with AEM is experiencing frequent downtime and slow page load times. The site receives high traffic, particularly during big fashion events and new product launches. The client is concerned about losing revenue and a decrease in user engagement due to the issues. An architect investigates the issue and discovers the following parameters: 
- Cache is not being utilized effectively, resulting in frequent calls to the repository for each page load 
- Logs indicate high CPU usage during peak traffic periods 
- The site is not optimized for mobile devices, resulting in longer load times for users accessing the site from their phones 
- Many images and files are not being properly compressed, leading to slower page load times What will the architect recommend to improve the site's performance and mitigate downtime issues for this fashion blog?
answers: Upgrade to AEM as a Cloud Service to automatically optimize caching and file compression
Utilize a CDN (content delivery network) to speed up page load times for users across different regions
Configure an auto-invalidation agent to flush the cache during peak traffic periods
Create a dedicated dispatcher farm for mobile devices and optimize cache configuration for all devices
correct: Utilize a CDN (content delivery network) to speed up page load times for users across different regions
reason: Una CDN acerca contenido cacheable a los visitantes y reduce las peticiones al origen durante los picos de tráfico. Esto puede aliviar CPU y mejorar tiempos de carga, pero debe acompañarse de reglas de caché correctas, compresión e imágenes adaptadas a móviles. Ninguna de esas mejoras se obtiene automáticamente por invalidar más caché durante el pico.

question:
A digital agency is planning to upgrade their AEM instance to version 6.5 in order to take advantage of new features and enhancements. Refer to the following parameters and requirements: 
- The current AEM version is 6.2 
- The agency is using MongoMK as their repository 
- They want to avoid any potential disruptions or data loss during the upgrade process 
- The agency’s AEM instance is heavily customized with various third-party integrations and custom code What should the agency do to ensure a smooth upgrade to AEM 6.5?
answers: Perform a clean installation of AEM 6.5 instead of an upgrade from 6.2 and migrate all content using a combination of content packages and automated batch scripts
Migrate the repository to the new version of Oak Segment Tar, utilize pattern detector to update all incompatible code and perform an In-Place upgrade
Utilize pattern detector to update all incompatible code and perform an In-Place upgrade from the AEM 6.2 instance using the latest 6.5 jar
correct: Utilize pattern detector to update all incompatible code and perform an In-Place upgrade from the AEM 6.2 instance using the latest 6.5 jar
reason: Pattern Detector identifica incompatibilidades que deben revisarse y corregirse antes de actualizar; no modifica automáticamente todo el código. Una actualización in-place debe ensayarse sobre una copia representativa, con copias de seguridad y regresión de integraciones. Al utilizar MongoMK, no corresponde introducir una migración a Segment Tar como paso obligatorio de la actualización.

question: A large retail company uses AEM to manage their e-commerce website. The site is integrated with various third-party services and systems for functionality and data management. Since the latest updates to Chrome and Safari browsers to versions 80 and higher, users reported being unable to log into the website and access their shopping cart. The company’s AEM architect investigated the issue and discovered that this is due to the default SameSite settings, which restricts the availability of cookies to third-party sites. What is the recommended solution for fixing the authentication issue caused by the SameSite cookie policy in the latest versions of Chrome and Safari browsers for AEM as a Cloud Service?
answers: Set SameSite attribute for the login-token cookie to Lax in Adobe Granite Token Authentication Handler and Update all third-party services and systems to be compatible with SameSite=Lax setting.
Set SameSite attribute for the login-token cookie to Lax in JavaScript and Update all the third-party services and systems to be compatible with SameSite=Lax setting.
Set SameSite attribute for the login-token cookie to None in Adobe Granite Token Authentication Handler
correct: Set SameSite attribute for the login-token cookie to None in Adobe Granite Token Authentication Handler
reason: SameSite=None permite que el navegador envíe la cookie en contextos entre sitios cuando esa integración lo requiere. Debe configurarse en Adobe Granite Token Authentication Handler y acompañarse de Secure y HTTPS. No conviene modificar por JavaScript una cookie de autenticación; además, las restricciones adicionales del navegador a cookies de terceros pueden requerir revisar el flujo completo de inicio de sesión.
